abstract: Under the assumption of the supply chain information fully shared and random demand, an independent decision model and a centralized decision model are established in wich the supply chain consists of one supplier, one TPL and one buyer. A revenue-sharing contract is designed and it founds that the Pareto optimization of supply chain can be achieved by selecting proper benefit-allotting coefficient, moreover EOQ, prices of TPL and supplier, range of benefit-allotting coefficient are given. Finally, according to the practice of Wenzhou Yuanda Logistics Limited company, some simulation experiments analysis are carried out.

articleTitle: Bidding strategy and participating threshold in online English auction with buy-it-now option
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: English auctions with a “buy-it-now” option are widely used in the Internet. This paper proposes a weakly dominant bidding strategy. It is optimal for bidders whose valuations are lower than the “buy-it-now” price to participate in the auction and bid their true valuations. Otherwise, bidders whose valuations are not lower than the “buy-it-now” price would make a choice between participating in the auction and pressing the “buy-it-now” button. It is optimal to bid the “buy-it-now” price if they decide to participate in the auction. We find that their decision on whether to participate in the auction or choose the “buy-it-now” significantly depends on the time remaining to the end of the auction.

articleTitle: Optimization for container Handling equipments allocation based on ARENA
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper focuses on a handling system of container port which used the technics of Quay Crane, Container Truck and Yard Crane. Then with the simulation software of ARENA, we build a simulation model for this system, and make an optimization to find the optimal allocation of equipments under the constraints of a certain equipment utilization and a minimum operation time. With the conclusion in our paper which overturns the experience resource utilization value, we can reduce the investment cost by optimizing resource allocation, also under the constraint of the certain equipment utilization.

articleTitle: The relocation planning for service centers of Chengdu
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper first analyzes the current situation and constraint of Chengdu service center. Then engineering analysis is made for Chengdu service center relocation. The facility site selection and layout plan are proposed, and the commitment is calculated. Lastly asset disposals and financial analysis are provided.

articleTitle: Study of cigarette logistics optimization based on value chain analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the deepening of the industry market-oriented reform and the increasing demand for the market demand responding speed, the role of logistics system in the cigarette business enterprise services value chain becomes more and more apparent. First, the value chain are analyzed, which are embedded in the modern cigarettes logistics. Second, the every link of cigarettes logistics is deeply disintegrated. Finally, by using value chain method, the cigarette logistics optimization is widely discussed, which will provide decision making references for the further enhancement of the competitiveness of cigarettes.

articleTitle: Research on the application of multidimensional association rule in construction accidents analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Recently, there have been more and more building construction accidents. Meanwhile, the reasons leading to these accidents are becoming increasingly complicated. In this paper, the multi-dimensional association rule is applied to help analyze the reasons of these construction accidents. This paper also shows how to identify the strong association rules among person, instrument, environment and accident types. Furthermore, through the application of the strong association rules in 387 cases, the frequent reasons leading to the accidents are identified and combined for the purpose of finding the regulations of the accidents. Finally, these rules are taken as the basis for the managers to make precaution decisions.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment based on proportional degradation hazards model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Proportional hazards model is introduced into dealing with accelerated degradation test data, and a model based on proportional degradation hazards model (PDHM) is proposed, the only assumption is that the logarithm of the degradation hazard function is a linear function of the stress covariates. The PDHM is established with degradation data, then the probability density function and Likelihood function of the model are derived, and maximum likelihood estimate (MLE) and Newton-Raphson method are utilized to estimate the model parameters. According to the relationship between failure threshold and degradation measure, the reliability model of the product is established, with which the reliability is assessed. The model in this paper is demonstrated correct and valid by assessing the reliability of percent increase in resistance over time of carbon-film resistors.

articleTitle: Dynamic vehicle allocation in Automated Material Handling System
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The Automated Materials Handling System (AMHS) in semiconductor industry is a significant to reduce the wafer cycle times and enhance the fab productivity. The determination of vehicle number, however, is challenging due to the complicated facility layout and the multiple reentries required in the manufacturing process. Previous research used to solve this problem based on the mathematical programming model, which does not take into account the highly variable and uncertain events in the process. In this research, we build a simulation model to account for the uncertainties existing in the manufacturing process. Furthermore, we propose a simulation optimization approach to solve the problem, i.e., to determine the optimal number of vehicles of the AMHS. An empirical study is conducted at the end to show the viability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Integrated simulation modeling for business process management: A case study in the machine manufacturing industry
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Modeling techniques play an important role when designing or managing a business process. Compared with the production process, the business process involves many uncertain factors caused by humans and organizational issues that make it difficult to model. To support process management and to measure the quantitative impact of possible changes in a business process, a computer-aided simulation modeling technique is proposed. This paper presents a case study on applying the simulation technique to analyze and redesign a sales and distribution process in the machine manufacturing industry. The potential utility of the simulation technique for supporting a business process redesign is discussed and validated.

articleTitle: Modeling of juice production line using simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With more competition and ever changing consumer demands, manufacturers are frequently realizing to reengineer their facility to satisfy the needs of many product groups. In such cases simulation can be a useful tool when analyzing complex production systems to help sort through cause-and effect relationships and gain a better understanding of what is actually causing a particular problem in the system. Once problems are identified, changes for improvement can be made more intelligently and then verified using simulation. The paper presents modeling of juice production line using simulation as tool. Objective is to estimate the present production line utilization and the bottleneck. The subsequent objective is then to suggest and verify a solution to enhance production capacity and reduce the bottleneck which results in the fulfillment of current and future market long term demand. Arena simulation package is used to develop the model.

articleTitle: Application of the ANP method based on entropy coefficients to evaluation of resource-based city innovation capacity
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to scientifically and objectively evaluate resource-based cities innovation capacity, the entropy is adopted to select the evaluation indexes, whose weights are then determined by analytic network process (ANP) model. This method is applied to evaluate Daqing's innovative capacity since 1998 to 2005. The result shows that the city's innovative capacity improved itself annually. The method possesses good practicability and has reference meaning for other resource-based cities.

articleTitle: Research on a quantitative model of coal mine safety management
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It is very important that to establish a rational and quantitative mathematical model for the safety management of coal enterprises. The model can help managers to develop practical safety management objectives. It can help people find out the safety production trends also. In this paper, time discrete state equation on the principle of Cybernetics was used to study coal mine safety production model. The parameter identification method based on Kalman filter is also discussed in detail. Example shows that this model is superior to the traditional regression analysis models.

articleTitle: Knowledge management and the formation of enterprise's core competence
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The goal of this paper is to analyze the definition and content of knowledge management, the relationship between knowledge management and the formation of core competitiveness of enterprises, and the countermeasures for the implementation of knowledge management. Firstly, we make an introduction about the definition of knowledge management, and also make an analysis about the classification and composition of knowledge management. Then we make a discussion about the interaction between knowledge management and enterprises competitiveness. We find that the core capability within the organization is a series of complementary combination of skills and knowledge, including technical capability, organization and management capability, and engage in market capability. Finally, we put forward the strategic routes and corresponding suggestions for the implementation of knowledge management for enterprises to realize their core competitiveness.

articleTitle: Availability of markov repairable systems with changeable operating regimes
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: More than one operating regimes are involved in a Markov repairable system with changeable operating regimes. The system can adjust its operating regimes to adapt to diverse exterior environments. Assume that the transition rate matrices under distinct operating regimes are different and the sojourn times in distinct regimes are governed by a finite state Markov chain. The availability of the system is studied using the matrix method, the Laplace transform and theory of Markov process. A numerical example is given to illustrate the results in the paper.

articleTitle: A study on manufacturer and suppliers for product innovation coordinating to avoid the risk based on game theory
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Conditioned cooperative relationship is being encouraged in supply chain management now. Apart from the non-cooperative game theories and methods in analyzing the competitive aspect of the relationship, cooperative or coordinated game theory is also needed in studying the cooperative aspect of the relationship between the enterprises in the supply chain. So game theory and methods are used widely in the risk analysis to coordinate manufacturer and suppliers. The game model of partnership between the manufacturer and the supplier for product innovation is established, the paper is focused on a finitely repeated game process based on product innovation, with its strategies analyzed and explained by the finitely repeated game theory, and the choice is the game model of Nash equilibrium solution. Finally the conditions and the importance of setting up the supplier-manufacturer partnership are analysised.

articleTitle: The effects of corporate environmental practices on financial performance of global companies
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to examine the relationship between companies' environmental management practices and their financial performance. We study a sample of the 500 largest public U.S. companies and we use Newsweek's Green Ranking index to predict future financial performance a year later. After controlling for size, industry concentration, firm's growth rate and risk, we are unable to find a significant effect. Therefore, we conclude that environmental practices have neither a positive nor a negative effect on financial performance. Further research could study a longer time horizon by taking longer time-lags into account.

articleTitle: Research of unidirectional automated Guided Vehicles System based on simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper presents a research of unidirectional AGVS (automated Guided Vehicles System) with battery management in a flexible manufacturing system (FMS) based on simulation. Although battery management is important for vehicle management, this problem is usually omitted in research. It is difficult to research the AGVS in FMS from using an analytic method. So in this paper, a parameterized simulation model of AGVS with battery management is built by using computer simulation. The result verified the reliability of the AGVS, and can be used in the future design.

articleTitle: Industrial value chain modeling and technology elements analysis based on IDEF0
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To identify the drivers and trajectories of upgrading, process modeling method based on IDEF0 for industrial value chain (IVC) is proposed. With a top-down modeling procedure, an industrial value chain is decomposed into structured layers of value creating processes involving elements of inputs, outputs, supporting mechanisms and constraints. Technology elements relating to these Value Process elements are analyzed to distinguish the technology drivers of upgrading. A mapping model based on QFD (quality function deployment) is developed to investigate the relationship between the Value Process elements and the technology elements. The proposed approach is applied to LED (Liquid Emitting Dioxide) industries for illustration.

articleTitle: Improving supply chain effectiveness through Collaborative Project and information technology governance
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The automotive industry comprises a complex network of supply chains which links the manufacturers to their numerous disparate suppliers. In a dynamic and uncertain supply chain environment, flexibility is the major challenge to manufacturers. In this complex network, decentralized and cross-company project management of automotive projects is the requisite mode of operation. Supply chain flexibility is thus contingent on close intercompany collaboration. It further requires the support of integrated inter-firm IT solutions and project governance frameworks to ensure consistent end-to-end value co-creation from the suppliers to the end customers of the manufacturer. From a case study of an automotive manufacturer, this paper proposes a combination of Collaborative Project Scorecard and Collaborative IT Governance for effective management of cross-company automotive projects and associated inter-firm IT systems integration to reduce inter-firm misunderstanding and mistrust so as to contribute towards attaining the `controlled flexibility' goal of the automotive manufacturing supply chain.

articleTitle: Considering modular level of product to minimize cost in reverse logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Recently, with the rise in environmental concerns, the reverse logistics have emerged. For the recycle of returned products, in addition to decomposition to selling, there is a method to make manufacturer reduce cost to import modularity production, its useable products can be consist of the number of modular components. The products can be dismantling after returned, and these products broken down into many higher residual standardized components, so that manufacturers can reuse these components. This research mainly examined the material and cash flow of modularity product in the reverse logistics, and discussed the variation of modularity level to the effect on recovered cost, inspection cost, component ordering cost, and manufacturing cost. And obtained what modularity level will make the optimal effect on the various cost and total cost.

articleTitle: Using regression model for eliminating the puzzlement of Non-Archimedean number in Data Envelopment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Since Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) had been developed, scholars have proposed solutions of the multiplier problem. Even though some of these methods have solved the problem of the value setting for multiplier, it causes several new problems. Some scholars even suggested the compromise solution, which would violate the essence of DEA. This research proposes the regression DEA model. It not only solves the puzzlement that the multiplier of every item in each Decision Making Unit (DMU) may be zero, also may avoid the puzzlement of setting Non-Archimedean small number(ε), which simultaneously has not violated the spirit of DEA. To compares with the result of Cross-Efficiency (CE) DEA model, the illustration demonstrated that the distribution tendency of each DMU's efficiency value extremely closes to each other; and it is able to confirm the discrimination of the Regression DEA method mentioned here.

articleTitle: Research on the evolving model of product warranty network
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, we explore the connotation of product warranty network based on the theory of cooperative networks in corporation and product warranty. On the rule of weight preferential attachment, local-world, attractive factor, the evolving model of product warranty network is proposed, giving distribution results of vertex weight and link weight. Both analysis and simulation results show that product warranty network demonstrates the characteristic of scale-free, which indicates that assuring relationship between corporations distributes unevenly. Most corporations have a small number of assuring relationships, whereas a few core corporations, exist as hubs in network, possess abundant assuring relationships, thus these corporations have the power of influence on the stability of the whole product warranty network.

articleTitle: Value distribution in industry-university networks based on the equilibrium between the common and private benefits
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A value distribution approach for industry-university network based on the equilibrium between the private and common benefits is studied. A dynamic value distribution process model is established in which the common and private benefits are distributed among the network members iteratively at the end of each cooperative stage. A value distribution model incorporating the equilibrium degree is formulated on the basis of cooperative game theory. A solution procedure based on GQP (Game Quadratic Programming) is also put forward. The proposed approach can achieve rational value distribution and the equilibrium between the common and private benefits of the partners simultaneously, ensuring the stability and efficiency of the industry-university network.

articleTitle: Analyzing quality management status Quo and relationship of food industry in China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Using ISO9000 series standards and the excellence performance model of China, we design a survey questionnaire to investigate quality management status quo of food industry in China. Through questionnaire investigation and statistical analyses, we find the quality management status quo of large-scale enterprises are better than that of medium-scales and small-scales, while medium-scale enterprises are better than small-scale ones in many aspects. Moreover, we analyze the relationships among system factors, processes factors and results factors, then find that the most important factors for food industry in China to improve product quality are `leadership', `basic management', `information and measurement', `design and development', `manufacturing and inspection' and `distribution and service'. We also find that the `distribution and service' is the only factor that affects product quality directly. For food safety respect, the improvement scopes are to enhance government supervision, communicate safety information among food supply chains, and reprimand illegal behavior rigorously.

articleTitle: Choosing reconfigurable configuration for an infusion bag's production logistic system using fuzzy AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Infusion bag's production logistic system are facing unpredictable, high-frequency market changes driven by global competition. So a more reconfigurable system configuration is needed. This paper focus on choosing the most reconfigurable configuration from several options. A fuzzy-AHP method composed of three levels including goals, factors and schemes is proposed. Weight of each scheme relative to goals is obtained, and infusion bag's production logistic system is designed according to the configuration with heaviest weight.

articleTitle: Assessment of communication protocols in the EPC Network - replacing textual SOAP and XML with binary google protocol buffers encoding
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The diffusion of RFID technology continues using the Electronic Product Code (EPC) as unique identifier for physical objects. The EPC Network enables companies to share information about read events by defining EPC Information Services (EPCIS). The communication protocols in the EPC Network are defined to be XML and SOAP. We claim that a binary encoded communication protocol is more appropriate given the fact that billions of read events will occur. We extend the Fosstrak EPCIS repository by binary encoded Google's Protocol Buffers. Our experimental evaluation shows that this switch in the protocol from textual encoding to binary encoding reduces the message size by about 75%, the processing time by at least 11% for XML and at least 59% for SOAP communication. With regards to the Internet of Things, our contribution shows the importance of the appropriate choice of communication protocols. We encourage that the EPC Network should be extended by a binary encoded communication protocol.

articleTitle: Linkage between continual improvement and Knowledge-Based View Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper reviews the literature and exhibits finding from case studies to provide a broad overview of learning and knowledge creation in the context of continual improvement. First, we describe Knowledge-Based View (KBV) theory and its application in the context of Continual Improvement (CI) initiatives such as Quality Control Circles (QCC), Kaizen, Business Process Engineering, and Six Sigma™ from literature. We then propose an integrated view of knowledge creation using Nanoka's theory of knowledge creation to provide insights on how the CI initiatives are supported by this theory, which later lead to improve the operational and organization outcomes. The case studies of three manufacturing companies, which implemented CI program and multi-certified management systems, are then presented to illustrate how KBV can be applied to support CI initiative. This embedding operations learning is a complementary to the organization's knowledge management system facilitating sustainable CI projects.

articleTitle: Coevolution of cultural embeddedness and industrial cluster's development: Case study of Shaoxing county textile cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As an important “soft environment” to industrial cluster's development, cultural embeddedness(CE) affects cluster's development by influencing the structure and behavior of cluster innovation system. From the dynamic perspective, there also exists coevolutionary process among these relationships. Based on longitudinal case study of the development of Shaoxing county textile cluster during the last three decades, we find this process leads to coupling in the early period of cluster's life cycle, but results in lock-in during the later phases. I.e the decline of clusters seems to be caused by the same factors that were advantages in the past. So we contend that it's important to make co-alignment and couple to cultural embeddedness and cluster's development in order to keep cluster's sustainable competitiveness.

articleTitle: Effect of organizational justice over affective commitment and the role of marital status
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This study aims at exploring the effect of ‘organizational justice’ over ‘affective commitment’ and the role of marital status, if any, in the relationship. A total of 207 responses from 18 organizations are collected and analyzed. The study has found that ‘procedural justice’ has positive effect over ‘affective commitment’ but ‘distributive justice’ doesn't have. It has also found that marital status plays a moderating role in between ‘procedural justice’ and ‘affective commitment’, but not in between the other relationship. The study has revealed that married are concerned about ‘procedural justice’ but unmarried are not. In fact, unmarried are not concerned about any type of justice. This finding points to importance of procedural justice to those employees who want to maintain long-term membership with the organization. Because, at the outset of the career procedural justice may not be important to an employee as he is unmarried, but as one gets married it will emerge as important. In such a situation, if organization fails to ensure it in the organization, it may lose those employees who are really talent.

articleTitle: Remote production dashboard: A real-time and online control technology for discrete manufacturing process based on knowledge service
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A viable and affordable real-time and online control technology named remote production dashboard (RPD) for discrete manufacturing process based on knowledge service is proposed. Firstly, the basic framework of RPD consisted of production environment layer, data process layer, knowledge service layer and man-machine interaction layer is constructed. Secondly, the principles of two key technologies used in RPD including real-time manufacturing field data capture and knowledge service are presented. Thirdly, the mechanism of RPD is described in detail and two running instances are given out. Finally, a prototype system is developed and applied to an auto motor manufacturer preliminarily. The RPD system facilitates the visible management of plant shop thus enhances the operational efficiency in a real-time manner, and is proved to be a promising next generation advanced manufacturing technology.

articleTitle: A study on the leaning toward kansei quality management system of foods with knowledge integration
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The kansei quality management of food reveals people's refined life. It improves the status of Chinese food by providing strategic opportunities of creating world-famous brands. From the perspective of knowledge integration, this article explores the leaning methods of kansei quality management, investigates the kansei quality of Chinese food, expounds two hypotheses of kansei quality management, summarizes the intrinsic links between kansei quality management principle and lean thinking and proposes the thought of kansei quality management to produce the exact food the users need-the creation of kansei values is fundamental to the satisfaction of consumers' demands. This articles seeks a breakthrough to the low kansei quality of Chinese food, makes a deep analysis to the kansei quality management process, compares the kansei quality of drinks, testifies the industrial methodology of the application of the kansei quality management in China, summarizes the system of kansei quality management to strengthen the competitiveness of the kansei quality of food and reflects on the philosophical paradigm of kansei quality management.

articleTitle: Comparison study of an in-house developed tool and commercial software for ANN modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This study presents a comparison of an in-house developed tool called Artificial Neural Network Model Developer (ANNMD) and commercial software for modeling with Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). The development of ANNMD is based on initiatives from previous experiences in ANN modeling of complex energy systems which require extensive examination of measured parameters in order to obtain reliable ANN models. The ANNMD is a generic tool the main idea of which is to perform fast, user-friendly modeling and with automated sensitivity analysis (SA) in conjunction with parameters that are important in every ANN modeling. In addition, commercial software for ANN modeling - which has been present on the market for more than a decade - was used. The comparison was established on the same basis with respect to network configuration, main training settings and data used, hence enabling as objective analysis as possible. Modeling time, number of trainings and model's accuracy obtained by the two tools were the measures for the comparison.

articleTitle: The rise and fall of R & D center's ‘Quality Management Department’ of a major ICT Based Chinese Organization in Pakistan: An exploratory, explanatory and analytical case study of core reason of rise and fall and corresponding soft benefits and dis-benefits for the overall organization
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper discusses, examines, explores, explains and analyzes the causes (reasons) and consequences (benefits and dis-benefits) of rise and fall of `Quality Management Department' of R & D Center of a major Chinese based ICT vendor operating in Pakistan. The paper presents finding of 5 years of qualitative research that required study of the subject from start to end. The given case required situational, thematic and subjective study. The findings of this case are presented in factual and temporal sequence so as to explain the studied issue in simplified form. The research for this paper is longitudinal, applied and inductive in nature.

articleTitle: Information integration in a dyadic relationship between producer and supplier: A case study on Holtab and its supplier
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Information integration enables firms to get real time information to cater the needs of customers, reduce order cycle time, accelerate response times and reduce cost in the supply chain. The paper aims at analyzing the present state of information flow between producer and its supplier, focuses on the ways and means of information integration between producer supplier dyad to ensure on time delivery of a critical component. A case study has been carried out using a qualitative research approach. Primary Data have been collected by observation and semi structured interview with the logistics manager and production manager of both producer and supplier. From the analysis and findings it is revealed that information flow both intra and inter-company is not smooth which creates the problem of uncertainty in the supply of critical component. To solve this problem both short term and long term solutions have been suggested based on the degree of integration required between the producer supplier dyad.

articleTitle: Supposed development of the system of management in industrial companies in the 3rd millennium
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Speeding of processes. Shortening the time needed for establishing new production. Maximum quality according to customers' demands. Complex services providing. Cost cutting. Reducing of series production. Flexibility of production. Increasing marketing demands. Increasing of purchase prices of fiscal assets. Shortening of fiscal assets lifetime. Markets globalization. Growth of competition. Low prices due to growth of competition. Relative decrease of costumers. Raising of demands on management. Loading of computer equipment to management. Integration of processes inside companies. Crossing from costs summing to their evaluation. Increasing demands to the information objectivity. Creating of databases for management. Increasing demands on exploitation of fiscal assets. Increasing of serviceability of fiscal assets.

articleTitle: Evaluation of a Genetic Algorithm based service productivity optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The development of efficient service projects is a critical success factor for companies. Often this goal can only be realized by developing project plans. The process of planning a service and optimizing the underlying project plan still lacks adequate knowledge and support. Existing approaches are not suitable for an optimization of services with regard to productivity prior to their implementation. To achieve improved service productivity, novel operations of a Genetic Algorithm (GA) for the prospective optimization of service projects are presented and benchmarked with plans developed by humans. As a result, managers will be able to develop service organizations related to optimal service productivity and thus avoid cost intensive false decisions.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the success of BPR based on BPR support systems
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, a new BPR (Business Process Reengineering) which consists of three support system, internal environment support system, capability support system and resource investment support system, is developed. Based on this, a conceptual model is proposed to describe the relationship between BPR and its three support systems. The empirical studies were performed with the introduction of factor analysis, correlation analysis and multiple regression analysis which belongs to multivariate statistical analysis methods, and the statistical software SPSS13.0 is used for the proof of the relationship between the BPR support system and BPR. Our investigation results show that the three support systems all play positive roles in promoting the success of BPR, but their separate influence is different, Based on our quantitative empirical and theoretical investigations, the critical support elements of the support systems were obtained. Our investigation results in this paper can provide important supports to improve the BPR performance and to promote its application to industries in future.

articleTitle: From Profit to Profit Potential — Redesign the performance indicator to support Toyota Production System
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The 20th century manufacturing management tended to “control” people by management accounting numbers. In order to survive the global competition, the management accounting must raise the precision of its measure so as to help, not control, the knowledge workers tap the reservoir of their tacit knowledge. Admitting the intrinsic effectiveness of ROA as the key performance indicator (KPI), while at the same time indicating the limitation of it for the purpose of measuring operational profitability, this paper proposes the notion of Profit Potential (PP), and offers the actual case of PP analysis regarding Japan's Big Three, including the after Lehman Brothers shock of the year 2009. The relative superiority of Toyota Production System (TPS) as well as its problem is exposed through the analysis.

articleTitle: Parameter selection optimization for parametric cost estimation based on Simulated Annealing
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Parametric is the most often used method for Life-Cycle Cost Estimation (LCCE), of which the Parameter Selection Problem (PSP) plays a key role in modeling Cost Estimation Relationships (CERs). It is generally computational infeasible to find out the optimal solution by comparing all the combinations of parameters when the problem is large-sized. Expertise was always counted on in the past. In this paper, we employ the modern meta-heuristic algorithm, i.e., an improved Simulated Annealing algorithm, to solve the problem of large-scale. We also present a mathematic optimization model for the PSP aiming at minimizing the average cost prediction error. A case study is given to show the principle of the proposed model and simulation experiments are carried out to demonstrate effectiveness and efficiency of this algorithm. The results show that this algorithm has a high probability in finding the optimal solution just by searching very small portion of solution space, which is satisfying.

articleTitle: Assessment of the reasons for failure and critical success factors implementing CI projects: Case study results from the South African Apparel and Manufacturing industry
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Utilizing case studies the paper investigates the reasons for the failure of Continuous Improvement (CI) projects in the South African Apparel and Manufacturing industries. There is an ever-increasing disquiet about implementation malfunctions in industry and the reason for the failures. During the 20<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> century, a plethora of quick fix CI methodologies were introduced. Management of organizations implements improvements without understanding the underlying principles of the improvement methodologies they attempted to implement. It occurred due to a lack of effective implementation guidelines that management could utilize. Management expects processes to miraculously transform through implementation of a particular methodology or set of methodologies. Management erroneously believed that CI projects would succeed without their active participation. Notwithstanding the failure of CI projects, a need for improvement of processes still exists in the 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century. There are various reasons why the improvements methodologies might fail. The authors identified the most common reason for the failure of CI projects in the South African context. As a result the authors endeavored to identify the critical success factors that would assist in a successful implementation of CI projects in South Africa.

articleTitle: Mode of constructing: The unification of the scientific criterion and the legal specification
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As an engineering technique, the building procedure should be complied with the relevant technical criterion so as to ensure the security and reliability of the building process as well as the construction products. However, the building may tamper with the adjacent owner( the adjacent right of lighting, sunlight Etc), the interest-related entity because of its traits of real estate. As a result, many disputes on property right have come forth. The appraisal on building lighting consists of two technical parameters including sunshine spacing and the duration of sunshine which connect with two different legal relations: administrative law and civil law. Obtaining the authorization of the administrative laws doesn't mean the exemption of the tortuous obligation on the civil laws level, criterion on construction is the unification of the scientific criterion and the legal criterion.

articleTitle: Integrated importance measure of binary coherent systems
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Importance measure in reliability engineering is applied to find the weakest component in a system. Traditional importance measures for the binary coherent systems mainly concern reliability importance of an individual component or its structural importance separately, but seldom consider the reliabilities, structures and causalities of the components as a whole. In order to solve the problem above, first of all, four kinds of popular component importance measures are discussed and their calculation methods based on probability distributions are also provided. Then, based on the limitations of such importance measures in system analysis, the integrated importance measure for the binary coherent systems is presented to describe the mathematical expectation of the system reliability decrease based on the current component failure rate. Finally, the simulation study is illustrated based on three typical connection systems. The results show the differences of five importance measures and prove the effectiveness of the integrated importance measure.

articleTitle: Empirical research on performance evaluation of effects on integration management of engineering projects
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on combination of related foreign theories and engineering practices in China, an index system of project performance evaluation has been explored and constructed. Furthermore, we applied the index system of performance evaluation to some cases according to their actual situations. The effectiveness of the index system of engineering projects was confirmed, and effect of integration management of engineering project was proved in practice.

articleTitle: An empirical research on the storage resources allocation of group enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the theory of non-convex interval goal programming and the discrete resources ideology, this paper constructs three basic storage resources allocation models, to illustrate the relationship between the aggregate requirement and the gross capability of storage in a group enterprise. Numerical results for the oil country tubular goods (OCTG) of 17 subcompanies of a group oil enterprise, verified the scientificity and feasibility of the models. These three models include: under the established demand, the problem-solving model of the best capability utilization, the decreased sensitivity analysis interval model of the best aggregate capability, and the interval optimization model of the external utilization efficiency of remaining capability.

articleTitle: A problem on claw-free homogeneously traceable
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In 1988 Faudree et al. proved that let G be a 3-connected K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1,3</sub>-free graph of order n, if |N(x)∪ N(y)|≥(2n-4)/3 for each pair of nonadjacent vertices x,y, then G is Homogeneously traceable. In 1991nian Bauer et al. proved that let G be a 3-connected K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1,3</sub>-free graph of order n, if |N(x) ∪ N(y)|≥(2n-5)/3 for each pair of nonadjacent vertices x,y, then G is traceable. In this note we prove the further result: let G be a 3-connected K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1,3</sub>-free graph of order n, if |N(x) ∪ N(y)|≥(2n-6)/3 for each pair of nonadjacent vertices x,y with 1≤|N(x) ∩ N(y)|≤α-1, then G is Homogeneously traceable.

articleTitle: Growth equilibrium analysis of enterprise ecological benefits based on eco-industrial chain
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Eco-industrial chain is en effective way to realize the coordinated development of economy and environment. It can maximize resources and energy use efficiency and minimize waste discharge by material and energy recycling in the chain, so as to achieve economy developments and environment protection. The internal relations of the coexisting eco-industrial chain are discussed in this paper first, meanwhile, the effectiveness growth model of eco-industrial chain is proposed to analysis ecological benefits development trends. The objective of this paper is to determine the ecological industry chain ideal operational mode for companies by analyze the equilibrium state of eco-industrial chain.

articleTitle: Transportation planning and design of the urban road intersection based on IE ideas
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on survey to the intersection of the main roads in Maanshan City, the paper combines the Industry Engineering theories and methods, gathers data and information about the intersection by the Work Sampling and Stopwatch to Time method, determines the average waiting time of vehicles by the M/D/1 model of queuing theory, carries out the comprehensive improvement to the existing access program with the Facilities Planning and Human Factors Engineering. Then, the evaluation and selection of access programs is executed by using AHP according to the certain goals. The results show that the analysis and improvement to the existing access program of the intersection can effectively reduce the traffic pressure and improve the traffic capacity in the premise of ensuring traffic safety.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation and suggestion about the real estate macroeconomic regulation and control policy
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article takes the real estate as the object of study, uses the theoretical analysis and the empirical analysis unifying the research technique, including qualitative and the quantitative analysis in the union real estate industry characteristic and real estate macroeconomic regulation and control process physical demand, carries on a more complete analysis to our country real estate macroeconomic regulation and control policy movement process. This paper designed the evaluation model of real estate macroeconomic regulation and control policy effects, established the policy which can influence real estate market development as a evaluating indicator system, finally analyzed the effects of policy and put forward the proposals.

articleTitle: Pricing strategy on supply chain and its algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The manufacturer and retailers of the supply chain will pursue maximization of profits in product pricing, which tend to show relations of game in which stackelberg game is a typical one. The pricing decisions of supply chain model with one manufacture and multiple retailers is established through multi-layer planning model in this paper. And the optimal solutions of this model is obtained through an improved genetic algorithm that adjust the searching range by the outstanding individuals which searched during the operation of genetic algorithm. According to numerical examples, the interest of each member can be guaranteed to maximize in the supply chain of distribution control type although the total profits of the best may not be achieved.

articleTitle: A robust (Q, r) inventory model regarding inaccuracy of point estimation of demand status
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Most literatures in design of (Q, r) inventory model assume that the expectation and standard deviation of demand are known. These descriptive statistics are derived by point estimation from historical data. While these point estimates used in the design may not represent the true demand status and sometimes may be far from true values. This inaccuracy of point estimation will lead to severe cost penalties. In this paper interval estimation is applied instead of point estimation. A robust design scheme following minimax framework is conducted to find a satisfying (Q, r). We use relative inefficiency to evaluate performance of a certain (Q, r) in the mini-max process. Relative inefficiency refers to the expected difference between the aggregated cost of (Q, r) and the minimized cost given a precise demand status. Cases are established to validate this scheme.

articleTitle: Online functional prediction for spatio-temporal systems using a generalized time-varying Radial Basis Function networks framework
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, functional prediction is carried out for spatio-temporal systems in which the spatial data is irregularly sampled. We propose a novel method called Kalman Filter Radial Basis Function (KF-RBF) for such a purpose. It casts the problem into a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS) defined by some continuous, symmetric and positive definite Radial Basis Function (RBF), thereby allowing for irregular sampling in the spatial domain. A Functional Auto-Regressive (FAR) model describing the system evolution in the temporal domain is further assumed. The FAR model is then formulated in a generalized Vector Auto-Regressive (VAR) framework embedded into a Kalman Filter (KF). This is achieved by projecting the unknown functions onto a time-invariant functional subspace. Subsequently, the weight vectors obtained become inputs into a Kalman Filter (KF). In this way, nonstationary functions can be forecasted by evolving these weight vectors.

articleTitle: A PACES model for B2B process servicizing
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The highly competitively environment nowadays erodes the gross margin of the manufacturing industrial. To earn more profit and to keep the competence, the company must extend its position in the “smile-curve”. One possible way to add business value is provide service for the customers. The manufacturing product plus market service can create a new business value and secure the market share. Facing the impact of environmental issue and the manufacturing meager profit time, the company therefore should figure out a better strategy to survive. In this article we deal with the manufacture servitization issues and propose a PACES model as the basis for the servitization of manufacturing.

articleTitle: Decision model and algorithm of distribution outsourcing of distribution centre from perspective of economical distribution—An expanded study on VRP
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper expanded study on traditional VRP by introducing the concepts of economical distribution area and distribution outsourcing according to actual distribution demand, and established decision models of distribution outsourcing from the perspective of economical distribution. It provided a dynamic particle swarm optimization algorithm based on subgroup collaboration for solving the models. Finally, the paper testified effectiveness of the models and its solution algorithm with experiment of calculation examples.

articleTitle: Constructing the Green Supply Chain Model of the international tourist hotel in casting service
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The main purpose of this study is applying TRIZ theory to construct the Green Supply Chain management (GSCM) strategies for the international tourist hotel. Based on the theory of TRIZ, we use the contradiction matrix to compare against the paradox of the environmental impacts, which were generated by the fine cuisine. Then we search for the solutions with TRIZ 40 innovation principles, propose our strategies, and construct a Green Supply Chain Model. Accordance with this GSCM model would offer the purchasing department of international tourist hotel feedback to the direction of purchasing process and the strategy of future planning. Moreover, the application of TRIZ creates its practical value for the specific industry in Green Supply Chain Management field.

articleTitle: Discrete-Event Simulation (DES) of uncertainty-based time-cost trade-off analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Critical Path Method (CPM) is widely used in construction engineering scheduling. Through calculating Early Start (ES), Early Finish (EF), Late Start (LS), and Late Finish (LF), the duration of a project can be obtained, and critical path can be found. However, in reality, the duration of each activity is uncertain with a distribution, instead of a constant number. Meanwhile, the cost of each activity may vary when the duration of the activity changes, generating different Net Present Value (NPV). In this paper, a Discrete-Event Simulation (DES) methodology is introduced to deal with the uncertainty-based time-cost trade-off (TCT) analysis in construction scheduling problem. An example is stated to verify the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Research of sustainable development of China's iron and steel industry CDM project
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper firstly introduces the Clean Development Mechanism (CDM) and presents the situation of iron and steel industry CDM project. Then it further studies methodologies on the assessment of the influence of CDM projects on sustainable development, analyzes and evaluates CDM projects effecting China's iron and steel industry sustainable development on the case of Wugang Coke Dry Quenching project. Finally, it makes some suggestions about how to promote sustainable development for China's iron and steel industry CDM projects.

articleTitle: Integration model of coal enterprises Activity-Based cost management information system and ERP
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Activity-based cost management involves lots of data processing and calculation, the management of computerized process is necessary. The coal enterprise Activity-Based cost management information system (C-ABCMIS) and ERP integration programmes are introduced in the paper, which use related methods and theory of documentary research, system analysis and information system integration, and face coal enterprise, combine the features of the coal enterprise and the development of ERP, give the integrated frame model from two angles of the new and existing ERP, and analysis the similarities and differences between the integrated programmes. Finally, a conclusion is drawed that the integration of C - ABCMIS and ERP is necessary and feasible.

articleTitle: Application study of genetic weighted matter element model on the evaluation of water resources social reproducible ability on city
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studies the evaluation of water resources social reproducible ability on the cities. First of all, it proposes research methods, namely the genetic weighted element model. Second, apply the model to five typical cities of the southern Xinjiang areas for empirical study. By the calculation, it gets the evaluation hierarchy of the water resources social reproducible ability in five typical cities. The evaluation results show that the water resources social reproducible ability of the five typical cities is very weak.

articleTitle: Supply chain risk management for forestry enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To adapt to the trend of globalization and empower the competition ability, the enterprises enter the supply chains, which provide the great developing opportunities and at the same time, aggravate the risks that suddenly exposed to the enterprises. To the forestry enterprises, because of their distinctive features, the supply chain risk management is different from the other industries. The traditional risk management methods do not work properly. This paper focused on the sources of the forestry supply chain risks, realized their severity, and pointed out the natural disasters, such as forest fires, diseases and insect pest injuries are the main risks among the various internal and external risks in supply chain. On the basis of them, the paper constructed the early-warning system based on the information sharing, configured its structure, narrated its five components functions, and lay out its operation procedures.

articleTitle: An analysis on the symbiosis capability of sports industry in China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Sports industry has a high correlation with other sectors of the national economy. At the same time, there is correlation within the sports industry. This paper makes a comparison analysis on China's sports industry in 2007 and 2008 by constructing a sports industry symbiotic model and symbiotic capability evaluation index: symbiotic degree, symbiotic coefficient and symbiotic capability index. It concludes that the symbiotic ability of the sports industry may change as time changes. The external environment of the sports industry will affect the sports industry's symbiotic ability. The entire sports industry symbiosis presents non-equilibrium, and some sports industry symbiotic coefficient is relatively large and at a powerful position. A balanced sports industry symbiosis symmetry coefficient should be floating around 0.5.

articleTitle: Problems and countermeasures in constructing knowledge creation mode of multinational corporations
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, aiming to the problems, which may exist in practical application of knowledge creation mode, we bring forward internal and external security institution-building of multinational corporations' technological innovation on the basis of knowledge management perspective. Internal security system of multinational corporations' knowledge creation is established separately from four aspects, which are the construction of transnational corporations on human resources management, information systems development, organizational culture, internal resources system construction. External security system of multinational corporations' knowledge creation, which has created conditions for smooth implementation of multinational corporations knowledge creation mode, is established separately from three aspects of host country, which are resource environment construction, industry environment construction, policy environment construction.

articleTitle: On correlation among variables in decision-making, construct factors of inventory decision-making and market performance - an empirical study on Taiwan's instant noodles industry
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Instant noodles were invented by Momofuku Ando, the founder of the Nissin Food Products Co., Ltd., The first package of instant noodles was formally launched into the market in 1958. This study, taking convenience stores as study samples, explores the variables in decision-making as well as constructs of inventory decision-making and market performance with regard to the instant noodles industry in Taiwan. The study is found that: (I). there are 6 factors affecting the inventory decision-making, and 8 variables have significant impact on “inventory policy”. (II). there are 6 factors affecting the market performance and 10 variables have significant impact on the above mentioned constructs.

articleTitle: Implementation of SHRM IA process model on Chinese assignees in Pakistan
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: International Assignment (IA) has been growing to meet the special skills, promote global integration, and develop future global leaders. SHRM-International Assignment Process model comprises 5 stages. This paper studies 3 Chinese companies, NORINCO, CETC and HUWAEI working in Pakistan, following of SHRM-IA Process Model. Research identifies the three week stages including Pre-departure Stage, On Arrival in Host Country and During the Assignment stage. According to the analysis and findings of the study, the home country HR Departments are also weak on creating awareness regarding language, culture, business environment, and other documentation procedures. Further research may be undertaken on a broader spectrum and compare the trends with Chinese International Assignees working in other countries as well. This research is of great value to Chinese Global Enterprises aspiring to excel on International Assignments to optimize performance of their assignees especially in the host country Pakistan.

articleTitle: Machine-process grouping algorithm using Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This research focuses on developing a machine-process grouping algorithm in which takes waiting time and setup time into the optimization's objective. The method used to find the best grouping is Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). Thus, the algorithm is named SWPSO (Setup & Waiting, PSO). A particle representation is created with dimension length equals to (M + P), i.e. sum of number of machines and recipes to be processed. The position boundaries are between 0 and min{M,P}. For the fitness function in PSO, estimations are used for both setup and waiting time. In particular for waiting time, there is a proportion of non-processing time in the makespan which needs to be found. Through repeated simulation, it is found that the actual makespan is 1.73 times the ideal one. Thus, there is a proportion of non-processing time as much as 0.73. The grouping result is compared with the result from previous research (Cheng, 2008). It is called SGRAM (Setup, Dendogram) because it considers only setup time and uses dendogram to find the best grouping. Comparison is also made with the original grouping, most number of groups, and no grouping. For most performance measures under different lot release policies, SWPSO shows better performance. In the comparison of two dispatching policies for SWPSO grouping, CR shows better performance than FIFO in all but average throughput. Furthermore, in additional cases where the numbers of machine and recipes to be processed are perturbed, SWPSO consistently shows better performance than or at least equal to SGRAM for most performance measures.

articleTitle: Fuzzy sets for purchase planning in uncertain conditions
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This work is devoted to the development of models and algorithms for purchase planning problem. For accurate and flexible purchasing it is important to be able to effectively combine input data from various types of sources. This paper proposes a method based on fuzzy sets to solve the problem of effective exploitation of expert knowledge and statistics of demand to determine the optimal amount of a purchase order. A membership function is used to model demand for a product. This membership function can be built using statistics, expert knowledge, or both. After membership functions for each product are created, purchasing optimization takes place based on these functions. The proposed approach supports decision making process based on formal methods of fuzzy, uncompleted or permanently changing information. The developed models and algorithms can be used for optimum assortment determination of enterprises involved in production and distribution of various types of goods.

articleTitle: Study on construction of Chinese carbon trading system in Post-CDM Era
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Global carbon trading market is growing stronger and will eventually surpass petroleum market to be the largest market in the world. As a major country of resource consumption, China has huge carbon trading market potential. Due to numerous uncertainties in Post-CDM Era, it's urgent for China to establish its own carbon trading system and participate in global carbon trading market. According to the above analysis, this paper has introduced four principles for establishing Chinese carbon trading system and finally presented concrete steps for establishing a system in details.

articleTitle: Study on high-tech zone enterprise incubator evaluation based on grey relational model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Enterprise incubators are services of cultivating and fostering high-tech zone center enterprises, which play an important role in promoting the development of high-tech industries, incubating and fostering the small and medium-sized enterprises, adjusting the industrial structure and fostering new economic growth point, and so on. In the process of growth in the number and diversity development, enterprise incubators gradually exhibited the problems of inefficient management, improper operation, low resources utilization, and so on. In this thesis the evaluation index system was established by selecting the factors affecting enterprise incubators, and multi level grey relational model was constructed based on grey system concept. An empirical study on high-tech zone enterprises was taken, therefore providing the reference for enterprises self-improvement and the government's effective guide.

articleTitle: A meta-model for actor-oriented, person-centered simulation for the management of development projects
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The simulation of work organizations in product development projects currently occurs almost entirely in a task and process-based manner, whereas the workers involved are only considered in an undifferentiated manner. The intended use of these approaches is the optimization of project progressions to minimize the project duration and cost. Although simulation models for project organizations exist, an optimal course of a project is often not achieved in reality. Therefore, a simulation model is presented to identify realistic courses of product development projects by taking the workers in the center of consideration. Thus the workers become the active part in the simulation model and the specific models of the involved actors generate the dynamics of the model. The novel approach considers the large scope of decision making for the workers involved in the project. The simulation model is based on a formal description of the elements and their relationships in the form of a meta-model, which is presented in a restricted selection. A verification study serves for the depiction of the closeness of the central model component, the prioritization algorithm, to reality.

articleTitle: Analysis on the enterprise legal relationship with supply chain management mode and its system establishment
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The relationship between cooperative enterprises with global supply chain management mode has changed profoundly. Thereby bringing correlative legal issues and raising legal risk. The paper constructed the legal relationship model of it by theory of jurisprudence and histology, then, the relational behaviors of contract parties and application of legal provision were analyzed in depth as well as the game analysis and risk analysis. Also the developing process of legal relationship and the network implemental structure of the second frame contract were described. Further more, the way and steps to control the legal risk was given. In terms of the constructing legal system, the questions of integration and unification were solved by using knowledge management technologies, and some of the suggestions for constructing correlative legislation system adapted to international environment and legal environment following the requisition of enterprise development was provided finally.

articleTitle: The capability evaluation of IE coordinated implementation based on the unascertained measurement model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Although Industrial Engineering (IE) is a scientific management technology of perfection and improvement of factories, there are many obstacles in the application process of IE in Chinese manufacturing factories. In order to make a platform and environment which can pave a road for the effective implementation of IE, we put forward the concept and construct the framework of IE coordinated implementation. Additionally, the unascertained measurement model is used to evaluate the capability of IE coordinated implementation scientifically in this paper, what is more, the evaluation results can enable the factories to discover, analyze and improve their weaknesses.

articleTitle: Research on the organizational model and human resource management based on advanced manufacturing technology
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studies the impact of advanced manufacturing technology (AMT) on the organizational structure and human resource management, for which new models suitable for AMT are presented. The proposed organizational model focuses primarily on the impact of AMT on organizational structure, organizational culture, organizational strategy and job characteristic; whereas the model of human resource management emphasizes four factors, namely, training, full authorization, reasonable rewards and teamwork. Finally, the relationship between technology, employees and organizations is analyzed and the adaptability to the organization for executive effect of AMT is explained in detail.

articleTitle: Study of modeling and simulation of Flexsim-based inventory management system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper examines the modeling and simulation process of an assembly line of a certain computer manufacturer. It employs the powerful re-develop technology of the Flexsim software to perform advanced simulation modeling, thereby eliminating the difficulties in the modeling of inventory management system and in its simulation optimization. This paper also presents the codes for advanced simulation. It has practical significance for facilitating the complex modeling of inventory management system, and provides managers with substantial analytic data and close-to-reality visual scenarios to make sound decisions.

articleTitle: Game analysis based on enterprises' work safety supervision
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The impotent supervision on work safety is a major reason leading to the serious conditions of unsafe production in China's enterprises. From the perspective of the game theory, this article makes an analysis of the supervision effect on the work safety of China's enterprises within the current system and mechanism, pointing out that the fundamental way to improve the work safety conditions is the system innovation and the encouragement of the supervisors' “efforts” in this aspect.

articleTitle: Research on allocating fixed cost based on externality computation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The proposal calculated by shapley value turns out to be an equally-shared proposal on the fixed cost by its nature. The present paper calculates the externality earning for each contributing interest of the fixed cost by using the shapley value based on the equally-shared proposal on the fixed cost, sets the expected recovery rate on externality earning in line with the scarcity of each contributing interest, participation willingness and attention on organization's earning, and modifies the original allocation proposal by redistributing the externality earning.

articleTitle: Multi-distribution center inventory demand forecast model in regional logistics network
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article is conducting a study on the demand forecast from the distribution network system composed of m-distribution centers and n-retailers. We analyze the characteristics of the regional logistics network. Use the Dijkstra shortest path algorithm and gain the shortest path distribution, based on which the inventory demand forecasting model which can obtain the total demand of each distribution center is established. Finally, an example is given to show that the model is correct and feasible.

articleTitle: Real Options for engineering management decision making
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper deals with an application of a Deferred Real Option to a solar energy project, to exhibit the importance of hidden opportunities in engineering management decision making. The project is first analyzed with the conventional Discount Cash Flow (DCF), and found to be unacceptable. It is then analyzed using a Decision Tree method with a Deferred Real Option and shows how the project becomes very desirable.

articleTitle: Study on the industry-university-research cooperation system: From the angle of labor division and cooperation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The industry-university-research cooperation system is a complex system, which has self-organization trait once the system is established that is same to other dissipative structure systems. The cooperation system evolution process includes three stages and has a complex structure. The industry-university-research cooperation system is a system includes many subsystems. The stabilization and mutual affect influence the efficacy of the whole system. The labor division and cooperation of subsystems influence the whole system function. So the essential of the industry-university-research cooperation is division innovation. The characters of different actors of the industry-university-research cooperation decide that they have different position and division. In practice many problems are due to the misunderstanding of the division and position. Some advises are put forward to enhance the cooperation of industry-university-research.

articleTitle: Research on customer requirements model based on α-cuts fuzzy weighted average method
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
