abstract: The quality of product development is affected directly by the quality and efficiency of early stage evaluation and decision of product design scheme; therefore, it is necessary to transfer vague requirements information from customer perspective to design, quantity, and engineering data. In this paper, a model of quality function deployment (QFD) was established, aiming at solving the fuzziness and uncertainty of early stage product design scheme. α-cuts fuzzy weighted average method was used to solve the model to transfer customer requirements information to technology data objectively and accurately. This method was tested by empirical study in the end of this paper.

articleTitle: Strategic alliance for enterprise knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper discusses the content and mechanism of strategic alliance and knowledge management in enterprise, focus on the transfer, sharing, integration, collision and protection of the knowledge; and with China's reality, it proposes a number of countermeasures and proposals about knowledge management when establish corporate strategic alliance, especially multinational strategic alliance. Ensure that the alliance enterprises to share knowledge - enhance efficiency - competitive advantages in mutual promotion and a virtuous circle.

articleTitle: Analysis on coal mine investment decision based on binomial tree pricing model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Coal resource plays an irreplaceable role in economy development, which decides the importance of coal mine investment. The influencing factors of coal mine investment are complicated and diversified, so the valuation should be flexible. In this paper, firstly, the concept and classification of real option are introduced. Then, combining to the compound binomial tree for stages, the principle and main equations of binomial tree pricing model are described. At last, net present value method and binomial tree pricing model are brought to do empirical research respectively. In this way, binomial tree pricing model is proved to evaluate coal mine investment project accurately, which to some extent can conduct how to invest the coal mine project with high risk.

articleTitle: Impact of technology-mediated learning on outcomes: Students' perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The present paper aims to examine the impact of course characteristics, namely course design, appeal and information quality on student learning outcomes in the context of technology-mediated learning. A questionnaire-based study of the above technology course characteristics and learning outcomes on a sample of secondary school students in India demonstrated support for the study hypotheses. Implications for e-learning service providers and school administrators are discussed.

articleTitle: Slipping time and velocity of footwear samples in friction measurements
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A friction measurement experiment was conducted using the Brungraber Mark II slipmeter. The coefficient of friction (COF), the time and velocity of slipping of the footwear sample on the floor were measured under four floors and two surface conditions. Two operators performed the measurements separately. The results showed that there were no significant differences between the two operators in measuring all the dependent variables. The ANOVA results showed that the floor, surface conditions, and their interactions affected the COF and velocity of slipping significantly (p<;0.05). The Pearson's correlation coefficient between the COF and the slipping velocity of the footwear sample was -0.81 (p<;0.0001). This implied that fast slipping was associated with low COF value. The slipping time and velocity of the footwear sample provided a basis to train the operators in making the slip and non-slip judgment. They are also helpful in developing an automatic friction measurement device that require slip/non-slip judgment.

articleTitle: Research of robust design in mass customization for automobile engine based on orthogonal experiment
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the characteristics of mass customization for automobile engine, a robust design in mass customization for automobile engine with orthogonal experiments is presented in this paper. Aimed at the customer demand - fuel consumption of 100km, defining 12 factors, calculating the SNR of every group experiment, analyzing the variance, achieving the best level combination of factors. Ultimately, the design method in mass customization for automobile engine meets customer personalization demand and makes the design factors more stable.

articleTitle: Research on the extraction of competency elements based upon the BEI & AHP method
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper concerns about the key sector in process of modeling competency —extracting competency specially. Draw support from the operational BEI method by Professor McClelland and AHP method with the combination of qualitative and quantitative analysis by the TL Professor Sati's. So that managers understand the concept of competency deeply, improve this competency-based method, and enhance the effectiveness and flexibility of human resource management activities

articleTitle: Research on the IE integrated innovation in China's light industry enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: There are 19 major categories of 45 trades in China's light industry which occupies a pivotal position in the national economy, covering food, clothing, traffic and entertainment in consumption of Industry Cluster. In the complicated and volatile buyers' market, disadvantages of inefficient management, high cost, lack of flexibility and so on, are seriously affecting the companies' survival and development. Because of multi-variety and low-volume production and a number of factors of production in light industry enterprises, in this paper, the philosophy of integrated innovation has been injected into IE which integrates organizations, knowledge and resources of the light industry enterprises to creatively improve the IE application effect of light industry enterprises and enhance the competitiveness of enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on the method of talents selection based on fuzzy preference relations
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Talents selection is a key step in decision making for Talents selection systems. According to selection method and flow of the talents is proposed based on fuzzy preference relation and C-IOWA operator, which can overcome the subjectivity of expert in the process of talents selection in great degree, and improve the efficiency and quality of group decision making.

articleTitle: Influence factors analysis of Chinese trust industry profitability based on RFA
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Analyze comprehensively and systematically the factors that influence trust efficiency through the three main respects, the macro factor, the industry factor, and the microscopic factor. And with the net profitability indicators being the dependent variable and the variable like trust scale, degree of innovation, stability, asset allocation as well as the corporate governance chosen respectively as the independent variable, the importance of each variable are calculate in the stochastic forest algorithm (RFA) method, and the relative effect of their importance on the profitability analyzed. The analysis showed that the main factors that affect the net profit of Chinese trust company are the scale and the stability while the asset allocation, the degree of innovation, and the corporate governance have little effect on the efficiency.

articleTitle: An optimal timing of merger and acquisition under cooperation opportunism and premium in real options and game-theoretic framework: Chinalco mergering Rio Tinto Plc for example
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studies on optimal timing of merger and acquisition for cooperative bidders under cooperation opportunism and premium. We incorporate Douglas production function as the way to get a common optimal timing of the two cooperative bidders which is in real options and game-theoretic framework. And then with different estimation of successful probability and premium level, we compare the real counted value of xb/xm with the theoretical threshold which are all based on the case of two cooperative bidders Chinalco and Alcoa mergering Rio Tinto Plc. And finally we draw the conclusion that the real counted value of cooperative bidders to merger the target was far away from their common optimal timing.

articleTitle: Study on the function of soft and hard equipments in fusion between industrialization and informationization
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Currently, the study of fusion between industrialization and informationization is a hot topic. Beginning with the introduction of the connotations and contents of hard and soft equipment, the paper introduced the relationships between soft & hard equipment and production models, the relationships of industrial software and enterprise informationization. At last, the paper elicited the “IE+IT” model, and emphasized that digital IE is one of the key technologies about the fusion between industrialization and informationization and service beneficiating.

articleTitle: Mapping out the global value chains of Chinese outsourced service industries: The case of ITO and BPO
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The globalisation of manufacturing outsourcing has been seen in the past decades. More recently service outsourcing has been globalised too. How do local firms insert into the global value chain (GVC) and how do the potential upgrading happened have drawn scholar's attentions. There is a lack of research into the area of globalised services production. China as an large market for global manufacturing outsourcing has been well researched, while it as an emerging destination of global service outsourcing activities received very little attention. In reality the two typical outsourced service industries: ITO and BPO have been always intertwined and linked, in theory they have not been examined in a one framework before. This paper aims to map out the value chain of Chinese outsourced service industries (ITO and BPO) and the potential upgrading opportunities available for Chinese outsourced service firms, attempting to analyse them in the same framework. Adopting a standard case study methodology the paper draws upon the qualitative data from 24 dispersedly selected Chinese outsourced service firms. The paper found out that the process/product upgrading and the functional upgrading are the most possible opportunities for Chinese outsourced service firms. The value chain upgrading is only seen from ITO to BPO.

articleTitle: Statistical thinking for engineers - what, why, and how?
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Many leaders in the quality profession, Dr. Deming being the foremost among them, have emphasized the need for engineers to have the ability to think statistically in order to understand and solve problems occurring in populations with variability. This article explains what statistical thinking is, why it is needed, and how the ability for it can be acquired. A series of real-world case studies show how statistical thinking helps in framing a physical problem in terms of statistical models, understanding the cause and effect relationships, and then devising solutions. A sample test is presented to define the range of statistical knowledge needed to gain the ability for statistical thinking.

articleTitle: Research on the benefit coordination of the stakeholders in BT project
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: BT model is a new kind of financing model emerged in the public project. The critical node of BT project is to coordinate the different demands of each stakeholder. Based on the stakeholder theories, firstly the stakeholders of the BT project are defined and classified in this paper. Then the benefits demands of the core stakeholders are analyzed and the reasons of the confliction are illustrated. Finally, this paper draws the conclusion that establishing reasonable benefit allocation mechanism is the critical solution of the conflicts among the core stakeholders.

articleTitle: Safety practices of a bus operator practicing one man operation during festive season
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Safety, Health and Environment (SHE) Code of Practice (COP) is introduced as one of the road safety intervention programmes as guidance for bus operators to implement safety and health in their working environment. The objective of this study is to investigate the effectiveness of SHE COP implementation of a single bus operator that has adopted one man operation. The data was collected by completing a set of checklist after observing the activities during pre departure, during the trip, and upon arrival. The results show that there are seven widely practiced SHE COP elements. In addition, the results show that 46% of the buses have average speed exceeding the maximum permissible speed on the highways (90km/h), and all the maximum speeds exceed the highway speed limit for buses. The statistical analysis shows that there is no significant association between SHE COP elements and the selected variables such speed and inappropriate driving behavior.

articleTitle: Qcc in lumber industry timber production quality improvement application
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: QCC which full name is Quality Control Circles is quality control tool and widespread use in Industrial enterprise at present. QCC origins in Japan, the enterprises call it the quality control group which is one kind of lively and special forms of action in the organization. A number of industrial enterprises have already introduced QCC and used in enterprise's quality control. At present, the QCC still not be used in the lumber industry enterprise. Take a state-owned forestry bureau as an example and try to apply the QCC theory in it on this paper.

articleTitle: The project failure knowledge representation method based on FCTA
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Learning experience and lessons from failure, building failure knowledge database and achieving failure knowledge management play an important role in avoiding and preventing project failure. And project failure knowledge representation is the premise of effective use. Considering the project failure's many paths, using failure-cause tree analysis technology (FCTA) to describe the project failure causes and the logical relationship between them. On the basis of the causes and knowledge of project failure, FCTA is proposed to describe the failure process of events graphically and a data structure is put forward to express project failure knowledge. Then this paper analyzes the application of the project failure knowledge representation method. Finally, a case illustrates the process of the project failure knowledge representation method.

articleTitle: A global optimization method for fuzzy analytic hierarchy process with application to New Product Development project screening
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A global optimization method for linear programming for finding the fuzzy priority vector in fuzzy analytic hierarchy process(AHP) is developed in this paper. Some rigorous mathematical definition and theorems for the optimization method are stated and proved. Instead of performing complicated computations, the graphical approach([18, p.30]) is used to find the fuzzy priority vector for the fuzzy pairwise comparison matrix(FPCM). This graphical approach is applied to New Product Development (NPD) project screening, which is a multiple criteria decision making(MCDM) problem. NPD is largely uncertain, because of competition accompanied with modern technology and market changes. It always leads to failure of new product development. The final project screening decision is obtained from the overall global fuzzy rates of the projects with respect to the screening criteria.

articleTitle: Permutation flow shop scheduling algorithm based on a hybrid particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The permutation flow shop scheduling problem is a part of production scheduling, which belongs to the hardest combinatorial optimization problem. A new hybrid algorithm is introduced which we called it HPSO, It combines knowledge evolution algorithm(KEA) and particle swarm optimization(PSO) algorithm for the permutation flow shop scheduling problem. The objective function is to search for a sequence of jobs in order that we can obtain the minimization value of maximum completion time (makespan). By the mechanism of KEA, its global search ability is fully utilized for finding the global solution. By the operating characteristic of PSO, the local search ability is also made full use. The experimental results indicate that the solution quality of the permutation flow shop scheduling problem based on HPSO is better than those based on Genetic algorithm, and than those based on standard PSO.

articleTitle: Analysis of coupling and interfacing mechanism for platform architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Product platform has been proven a successful strategy in business practice, and platform architecture is crucial to platforming strategy. In this paper, some issues on platform architecture are firstly discussed and argued. Then an analysis tool termed as interfacing analysis matrix (IAM) is presented for the analysis of base platform architecture, with improvement of the existing analysis tools for architecture coupling. The base model of a cordless drill is finally applied to exemplify the significance of IAM.

articleTitle: Study of entrepreneurship enterprises cluster's collaborative innovation mechanism based on endogenous collective action perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The willingness of endogenous collective action in enterprises clusters is an essential force to offer public goods. Based on the foundation of the enterprises entrepreneurial action and endogenous collective action, this paper studies the functions of leading enterprises, entrepreneurs, industry association and local government during cluster collaborative innovation process, puts forward relevant suggestions for successful techniques in the High-tech Park.

articleTitle: Statistical process monitoring of between-part and within-part variations using independent component analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The data collected from in-process measurement usually contain useful information about the nature of the source of process variability. In this paper, each variation source is assumed to generate a different spatial variation pattern in the quality characteristics measurements. The variation source might also reveal interesting temporal pattern over the data sample. The spatial variation pattern and temporal pattern caused by a variation source may turn out to be the observed within- and between-part variations in the monitoring of product measurements. The study reported in this paper aimed at applying independent component analysis (ICA) to monitor within- and between-part variations. Various monitoring statistics obtained from ICA are used to construct the control procedure. The average run length (ARL) is used to measure the abnormalities detection performance. An extensive comparison based on simulation study indicates that the ICA-based control charts perform better than conventional control charts in terms of ARL. The paper contributes to the monitoring of within- and between-part variations.

articleTitle: Study on the dynamic characteristics of BBV weighted network
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the study of complex networks, weighted networks have been applied to various fields, as such mediums can provide more realistic and comprehensive description of reality. In this paper we study BBV (Barthelemy and Vespignani) weighted model as well as its dynamic properties of complex networks, which could play an important role both in theory and practical applications. Through comprehensively theoretical derivation, we take the degree-strength correlation into account, and deduce the analytical expressions of the power-law exponent of the degree distribution. Most importantly, we carry on further studies on parameters influencing the network statistics of degree distribution and clustering coefficient. Numerical simulations show some parameters besides δ exert significant impact to the network statistics as well, which has been neglected by most scholars for long. However, conclusions in this paper fully represent the small-world characteristics and scale-free properties of BBV weighted network.

articleTitle: DEA-based assessment model for identifying human unsafe behavior in coal mine enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Statistical data shows that most of the accidents in Chinese coal mine enterprises are caused by human unsafe behavior. Therefore, establishing a sophisticated assessment index system can effectively predict human unsafe behavior. The traditional method is to use AHP-Fuzzy to evaluate human unsafe behavior. But this approach is one-sided, because its result is easily affected by decision-makers subjective factors. Based on GB6441-86, this paper establishes a safety index system for identifying unsafe behavior of coal mine enterprises, and uses DEA method to establish a safety assessment model. By the contrast between affiliated mines of a certain large state-owned coal group, using DEA method is more specific and objective to evaluate the effectiveness of these mines in safety management of unsafe behavior. The purpose of this paper is to help to reduce the accidents caused by unsafe behavior and to achieve optimal safety production in coal mine enterprises.

articleTitle: The study on development project of manufacturing logistics at the facing harbor gather'S District In Qinhuangdao
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on describing current situation, this paper firstly analyzes the inside condition and the outside environment on logistic industry by the method of SWOT at the facing harbor gather's District in QinHuangDao. Then it determines the strategy and specific task in the near future and in the long-range view. After that, it designs logistic system and plans function in logistic garden, and designs three project gorups which could provide direction for inviting investments on government.

Author Keywords: The industry chain of manufacturing auxiliary center
The industry chain of center of distributing within region
The industry chain of center on facing harbor

articleTitle: A research of intelligent parameters searching in small data sets
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Increasingly competitive in a global economy, the lifecycle of product become shorter and shorter. How to shorten the time during research and development period, especially in the early stage in the industrial lifecycle is now an important issue. Unfortunately, lack of sufficient data always is a problem while acquiring knowledge in early stage. Therefore, this paper focuses on small data sets and further provides a systematic way for parameters searching. Our methodology is effectively selecting experimental parameter settings for redefining the boundary of parameter settings iteratively. There are four stages in our methodology: virtual sample generation, classification, selection and performance testing. In this paper, we design two experiments for verification four different selection mechanisms (RS, SVS, LVS, GVS). Furthermore, LVS and GVS mechanism will be discussed in the convergence experiment.

articleTitle: A production planning method based on fuzzy chance-constrained programming
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to accurately describe the uncertainty in production environment, an approach on making production planning with fuzzy information is proposed. Based on the credibility theory, a fuzzy chance-constrained programming model is established. With the uncertain information presented as trapezoidal fuzzy number, the model can be transformed into its corresponding crisp equivalent model. In the end, the proposed approach is applied to a realistic fuzzy APP problem, and the result demonstrates that production planning can be modeled into a fuzzy chance-constrained programming and the model can well describe the uncertainty in actual environment.

articleTitle: The effect of strategic orientations and knowledge acquisition on product innovation— The moderating effect of control mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the organizational learning theory and social exchange theory, this article builds theoretical model to describe how different types of strategic orientations affect the knowledge acquisition; and the moderating effects of both informal control and formal control on the relationship between the EO, MO LO and knowledge acquisition of local venders. Our results show that, there are the positive relationship between the EO and knowledge acquisition; the positive relationship between the LO and knowledge acquisition; the invert-U relationship between the MO and knowledge acquisition. Furthermore, the knowledge acquisition has positive effect on product innovation. Finally, the different types of formal control and informal control have the different moderating effect on the relationship between the strategic orientation and knowledge acquisition.

articleTitle: On the formation of mathematical model in the defective design in mechanical products
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Design flaws are important factors that influence the quality of products in mechanical engineering, and the thorough study on the formation approaches is of far-reaching significance to improve product quality. Flaw factors are the internal factors of defective design. This paper combines the concept of neurons in a detailed description of their internal composition and, on the basis, ascertained the conversion relation of defect factors from the input to the output. By applying S function and Copula connection function, the system function and the threshold function of defect factors were successfully constructed, and this set up the mathematical foundation for studying quantitatively the model of forming design flaws. Finally, as an example, the paper gave the design failure analysis of a mechanical product design process and proved the correctness of this research method.

articleTitle: System analysis for Contractor Prequalification based on P-DEA method
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Contractor Prequalification plays an important role in the bidding process of construction projects. Both the employer and the potential bidder attach great importance to it and many methods of prequalification have been used. This work propounds a potential bidder evaluation system, which is more suitable to the situation of construction project bidding. Compared with Weight Grade Method, P-DEA is more improved in reliability, objectivity and soundness. The “Practical Frontier” given in the work can be deemed as a regional industry standard, which may become either the foundation of prequalification or a reference for the contractor to improve performance.

articleTitle: The technological catching-up research based on spatial knowledge spillovers
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Considering spatial knowledge spillovers of the economic belts surrounding the Bohai Sea and the Yangtze River Delta, the paper unveils the conditions realizing regional technological catching-up in china by discussing the catching up in above areas, which provides reference for regional development as a whole and implementation of technological catching-up in less developed regions.

articleTitle: Business success through business excellence? Current status, concepts and perspectives
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The research into explanation of business success is being performed since decades. Two different approaches can be identified which are wide spread. The one concept follows the quality movement and evolved into several comprehensive models which guide organisations on their way to excellence. The other concept tries to identify success factors which attribute to business success. In this paper these two concepts are addressed and a proposal to integrate both concepts within the framework of integrated management systems is being outlined.

articleTitle: Multi-agent modeling on scheduling of multi-variety and multi-process job-shop
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A new method for modeling and analyzing scheduling of multi-variety and multi-process job-shop based on multi-agent was proposed to effectively solve the dynamic and complex scheduling of multi-variety and multi-process job-shop problem. A physical and mathematic scheduling model of multi-variety and multi-process job-shop based on multi-agent was established. The analyzing scheduling system obtained the target function based on six kinds of agents such as planning agents, searching agents, negotiating agents, deciding agents, logistics agents and database agents. A system was designed to realize the analyzing scheduling of multi-variety and multi-process job-shop with Java programming language. The scheduling of the job-shop in a certain national automobile liner production enterprise was taken as an example. Results proved the validity and reliability of this multi-agent model and scheduling system.

articleTitle: Inverse dynamic analysis of the 2-DOF parallel platform with actuation redundancy
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The dynamic formulation is presented in this paper. On base of a method which refers to the principle of virtual work, the inverse dynamic model of the 2-DOF parallel platform is set up. The dynamic formulation is a system of equations including two equations and three unknown quantities referring to three driving forces. Therefore, the solution of the driving forces as to the system of equations is carried out by employing the generalized inverse matrix with minimizing an objective function which is the square of the sum of three driving forces.

articleTitle: Tactical guarantee network survivability cascade failures analysis based on probability generating function
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Characteristics of tactical guarantee network are analyzed, based on which a network model with uniformly random degree distribution and cascade failure survivability model is proposed. Supposing network nodes' initial capacity and load were equal, the critical point of network cascade collapse is derived by probability function method analysis. The research shows that: as network load increases, there will be a critical load value. When network load exceeds the critical value, a random node failure in the network will cause the entire function network to collapse. Finally, computer simulation is applied to verify the correctness of the analytic deduction.

articleTitle: The emulation analysis of production, circulation and dual structure model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The combination of Karl Mark' circulation theory and dual economic model is adopted in order to solve the problem of industrial development limited by dual structure. The results are as follows: Insufficient supply of agricultural products and insufficient demand of industrial products coexist in dual structure. And it is crucial that the insufficient supply is solved first to stimulate dual economic growth and integrate the available resources. With constant technique, industrial economic growth in dual structure is mainly influenced by agricultural commodity rate and labor force movement into industry. The movement is accelerated by improvement of agricultural commodity rate. Consequently, it is investment in agricultural products circulation, including logistics and information flow, that is a significant way to increase the effective supply. Division of labor is introduced to circulation analysis, and circulation theory is used to develop dual economic model creatively. The results provide new insights into industrial economic growth in dual structure.

articleTitle: Corporate financial structure and output fluctuations: An empirical analysis of Chinese listed companies under the US subprime mortgage crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper combines latest research achievements of financial structure and financial crisis, with the use of Chinese listed companies' data from 2007 to 2008, and examines the impact of companies' different financial structure, especially the debt structure on their output during the subprime mortgage crisis by empirical study. The empirical results reveal that the change in output growth has remarkably negative correlation with debt to equity ratio and bank lending to debt ratio under the crisis. The crisis amplification through the credit channels has a much larger negative impact on output growth than the balance sheets effect. During the crisis period, there is a significantly positive correlation between the open market debt ratio of total debt and the variable in output growth ratio.

articleTitle: The heat balance study on regional second-hand commercial residential industry
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper, starting from the analysis of the second-hand residence transactional type indicator of Tianjin city, through large quantity of statistical work, adopts the method of heating analysis graphics in analyzing in depth the heat balance situation of the second-hand residence of various areas of Tianjin. It intuitively discovers the developing trend of regional residence transactional market and the heating level of residential market. The results show that heat analysis diagram method is a simple and intuitive, fast and effective method of real-estate regional balance analysis, and its conclusions are reliable, which can provide important information and policy supports for the government, the economists, consumers and real estate developers.

articleTitle: The research on the constitution of Financial Logistics Management System
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Financial Logistics is an innovation of logistics service. It is a kind of logistics service with financial supporting functions, e.g. cheques distribution, records storage, cash escorts and supply chain finance, etc. A properly-constituted Financial Logistics Management System will be helpful for the financial institutions to manage their operations more efficiently and effectively, as well as to reduce the relevant risks and costs. Therefore, the research on the constitution of Financial Logistics Management System is very essential as both the logistics service providers and financial institutions should have clear understanding how the system is constituted and how it works. The research is also helpful to enhance the capacity of Financial Logistics Management System, so as to improve the competence of financial institutions in a long run.

articleTitle: Supplier relationship evaluation model of construction enterprises based on CMMI
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Supplier relationship management is the key to enhance the market competitiveness of construction enterprises, and how to assess the relationships between the two sides needs to be solved by the construction enterprises immediately. Based on summarizing and analyzing the relevant literatures, this paper introduces the Capability Maturity Model Integration theory (CMMI), divides the relationships between the construction enterprises and the suppliers into four levels, and establishes an evaluation index system, which constitutes the CMMI-based relationship evaluation model. Finally, this paper selects the PROMETHEE method to assess the relationships between them, and points out the existing problems, which effectively ensure continuous improvement of their relationships and improve the enterprise competitiveness.

articleTitle: A distributed Workflow Management System for Collaborative Product Development
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Collaborative Product Development (CPD) has been widely accepted as an advanced paradigm to combine geographical distributed project teams to develop more competitive products. However, the process management for CPD is still a challenging research issue due to the distributed and dynamic nature of the problem currently. At the base of our previous study on process-view approach for inter-enterprises workflows, a P2P based and Web services-oriented distributed Workflow Management System (WMS) is built in this paper, which provides a scalable and flexible architecture for CPD process management. At last, the collaborative development of the motor, clutch and frame of an automobile is given as the case study, to validate the built distributed WMS.

articleTitle: Estimation of repeatability and between-method reproducibility using a novel statistical model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Measurement uncertainty is used to describe the quality of a measurement value and ensures the ability of a laboratory to reliably implement quality improvement initiatives. The repeatability and reproducibility (R&R) study is the program most widely used to assess measurement uncertainty. R&R study is based on the assumption of a normal probability distribution of measurement results. However, standard R&R methods are inadequate for evaluating measurement uncertainty in numerous situations involving an insufficiently realistic normality assumption. This study proposes a statistical model for determining the R&R variance for inter-laboratory measurement results. The Expectation Maximization (E-M) algorithm and generalized linear model (GLM) are applied to estimate the repeatability variance, and a developed method is designed for estimating inter-laboratory and reproducibility variance. The findings are employed to evaluate and improve measurement uncertainty in laboratory accreditation.

articleTitle: The improvement on the value of construction products within the scale of social value
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The value of construction products can be evaluated from the cope of user, builder and society on the base of Total Value Management. Construction products are high energy-consuming products, while energy saving is an effective approach for those products to improve their value. In order to secure the cost of the consumers and society, the “off-wall cost” of producers' cost must be attached importance to by the designers and the builders under the frame of total life circle. Proper construction proposals or new construction measures will be able to help achieve the goal that, with equal or slightly higher production cost, construction products will achieve energy conservation and emission reduction on the social level, and the client's utilization will be increased, all that will achieve value maximization of construction products and the increase of total value.

articleTitle: Using GRA and MPI to assess of Intellectual capital management for Taiwanese pharmaceutical industry
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Fast technology evolution is considered as the most important factor for economic growth. The management of technology is one of very essential issues for outstanding enterprises. Technology is the core of intellectual capital (IC). Most of the studies regarding IC were focusing on the contents and measurement. This study will be more directing at how to utilize IC more effectively in order to improve the performance of enterprises. GRA and Malmquist Productivity Index (MPI) are employed to research the relationship between business performance and management of IC for Taiwanese pharmaceutical industry. The research results show that 7 companies have better business performance due to more superior IC management; however, other 5 companies have room for improvement. These results should be very valuable for both academic study in future and business enhancement.

articleTitle: An SVR and single response modeling strategy based RPD approach for multiextreme processes
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Robust Parameter Design (RPD) is one of the key approaches to improve product quality. The paper proposes an RPD approach for optimizing processes with multiextreme quality characteristics. Firstly, support vector regression (SVR) is selected as the basic fitting model for a concerned process. Secondly, uniform space filling design is used to arrange the levels of control factors and noise factors, and single response modeling strategy is adopted to fit the SVR model. Thirdly, process mean and variance are estimated according to the probability density function of noise factors. Lastly, RPD is achieved by solving the optimal problem. The results of a simulation study for the larger-the-better problem show that, compared with dual response surface methodology, the proposed approach can well reconstruct the multiextreme response surfaces of process mean and variance and obtain global optimal solution of RPD with higher accuracy, all of which demonstrate the superiority of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Modeling of a Build-to-order supply chain with fuzzy costs
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Worldwide organizations are striving to improve their productivity in order to stay competitive in the global market. The process of supply chain has become complicated and uncertainties prevail at every stage in the chain. Effective supply chain has become an imperative in order to increase customer satisfaction, reduce costs and handling of demand supply scenario. The Build-to-order manufacturing system is a demand satisfying strategy of supply chain that is involved in assembling of customized products. Adopting a Build-to-order strategy would allow firms to effectively customize their products to a greater degree towards meeting specific requirements of customers. It is proposed to implement an abstract view of a single product, Build-to-order supply chain system for a computer assembling organization. The uncertainties associated with the estimation of various operational cost parameters of the computer assembly are represented by fuzzy numbers. A fuzzy mathematical programming model is developed and utilized for a case study organization is used to evaluate the uncertainty in operational cost. The model is comprised of three objective functions with various cost parameters. This Multi-objective linear programming problem is then reduced to an equivalent single objective linear programming problem. The method improves possibility of getting imprecise total cost. The above model can be extended to other BTO products such as cars, furniture and electronic appliances.

articleTitle: The decision analysis and methods for enterprises to retain the core human resources
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The core human resources are core competence for enterprises. Evaluation and development of the core human resources retention strategy are the keys to obtain core competence for enterprises. Based on quantitative research on decision analysis and methods, this article evaluates and formulates the enterprise's core human resources retention strategies. The decision analysis and methods solve the problems, retain the core human resource for enterprise, and help the enterprise use data analysis to prevent the loss of core human resources.

articleTitle: The modeling and optimization of process of heart first aid based on generated stochastic Petri nets
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Aiming at the characters of emergency, urgency, continuity, and criticality of heart first aid, generated stochastic Petri nets was introduced to model and optimize the process of heart first aid. In the process, the stochastic time was taken into account, and the time characteristic of the process was analyzed. Via process optimization, the execution time of each node was shortened and efficiency of heart first aid was improved.

articleTitle: Building fire protection system reliability analysis based on GO method
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper presents the application of GO method in the reliability analysis of fire protection system in buildings, and chooses eight reliability characteristic parameters from the aspects of reliability, maintainability and availability. The example of the water-spraying hydrant system of one building is given using the method proposed in the paper. The results show that the GO method is very simple and useful for the reliability analysis of repairable systems. Finally, the paper designs and develops the reliability evaluation software.

articleTitle: Study on the development of partners on enterprise of service in tourism
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: By establishing the partnership, enterprise of service in tourism can realize the resource and risk sharing and to partners, and achieve a win-win situation. In order to avoid the one-sidedness and blindness of selecting partners, we select partners by the fuzzy synthetical evaluation method, and manage to partnership, so as to improve the overall quality level of supply chain and the service competitiveness of enterprise in tourism tourism.

articleTitle: Information management system of three-dimensional (3D) anthropometric data based on GLScene
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) anthropometric data can be obtained more easily in the last decades, and numerous applications can be realized by using 3D data. However, how to manage large scale 3D database is a most challenging task yet. In this paper, an information management system of 3D anthropometric data using GLScene, a Delphi open source widget based on OpenGL technique, was proposed. The data was drawn from the first national 3D anthropometric survey of Chinese minors, conducted by China National Institute of Standardization. Also landmark manual identification and measurement automatic extraction were implemented. The measurements are in accordance with the definitions of ISO7250.

articleTitle: Single-machine scheduling with general deteriorating jobs and learning effect
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, we provide machine scheduling problems with general deteriorating jobs and learning effect (GDJLE). The job processing time is a function of its starting time and its position in the sequence. Firstly, we explain that the job-position-based(JPB) learning and starting-time-based (STB) deteriorating models in the literature are exceptional cases of the proposed model. Furthermore, we introduce polynomial solutions of some single-machine problems.

articleTitle: Applied technology forecasting model on evaluation of quality growth
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The product quality will be growth as operational time and experience increase after a production process introduces a new technology. A growth curve can forecast the quality growth. This study applies a logistic growth curve to constructs an evaluation method of quality growth for larger-the-better characteristic. The parameter estimation method of logistic growth curve was also developed. An example of IC packaging was given to illustrate the application of this evaluation method.

articleTitle: Time-cost trade-off problem under uncertainty incorporating multi-objective genetic algorithm and fuzzy sets theory
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The time-cost trade-off problem (TCTP) is an important branch in the project scheduling problem. However, the duration and cost of each activity could change stochastically as a result of uncertain factors. To meet the needs of real projects, an improved approach based on trapezoid fuzzy numbers is applied to estimate the uncertainty of time and cost. And then α-cut method is applied to decide the risk level. Furthermore, improved crossover and mutation methods for multi-objective genetic algorithm (MOGA) are used to make a large-scale computation possible. The efficiency of the proposed approach is verified by comparison with previous researches. In addition, economic analysis skill of finance cost is integrated into the new model to provide greater flexibility to managers when making decisions. Finally, time-cost tables under different risk levels for case examples are given and the advantages are investigated based on computation results.

articleTitle: An analysis method for robustness of mechanical process scheme based on VMEA and TRIZ
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A technical framework which is based on Variation Mode and Effect Analysis (VMEA) and Theory of Inventive Problem Solving (TRIZ) for analyzing the variations or couplings exist in process scheme is presented firstly. Through the usage of VMEA method, an approach is proposed to detect the latent variations and couplings of process system, with the aim of reducing the variations of process system and improving the robustness and quality of process system. The key variations in process system will be identified by the rank of Variation Risk Priority Number (VRPN) which is calculated in a fuzzy perspective. Then use TRIZ theory to analysis the key variations or couplings and find the feasible solutions to solve them. Finally, a case study about a process scheme of a mechanical product is given to validate the correction of this method.

articleTitle: Dimentional inspection and feature recognition through machine vision system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Automated computerized machine vision inspection, techniques can be used as a tooling for automated shape inspection in an advanced CIM environment so that real time, reliable, non-contact and non-destructive, and 100% quality measure activities can be achieved fruitfully. This paper develops a generic hardware system, software architecture and a technology-mix for product feature identification and measurement analysis of various machined parts/products. The feature analysis seeks to identify inherent characteristics of feature of an object found within the image frame. These characteristics are used to describe the object or the attributes of the object features, prior to subsequent task for classification of the same. The special features of such an inspection methodology include system which is (i) Micro-computer based; (ii) flexible and reprogrammable; (iii) likely to remain effective at the floor; (iv) ensure the highest possible goes to the customer and (v) very efficient.

articleTitle: The study on decision-making criterion of public projects
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: All decisions are a selection process under the guidance of certain values. At present, utilitarianism, deontology and justice theory have greater impact on the decision-making. By analyzing the strengths and weaknesses of these value theories, we argued that the decision-making values of public projects should be justice and utilitarianism. On this basis, this paper studied the interests achieving mechanism from the perspective of public project stakeholders. However, the public is in a special status in the process of public projects decision-making. This status makes public projects decision-making criteria to be the public satisfaction. Which the public participate the decision-making is the achieving mechanisms of the public satisfaction.

articleTitle: Study of passenger transport price ratio based on the transport supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper is a study of the passenger transport, focusing on an effort to find put the bottleneck in the passenger transport development in China through a scientific analysis of the pricing relationships among various modes of transport and further to show the pricing flexibility of the passenger traffic in accordance with the supply chain. Employing the analytic hierarchy process, the authors chose a number of different types of passenger transport in different routes and areas and made a comparison and analysis of their prices, which was subject to real demonstration tests. A conclusion is finally reached that by adjustment of pricing, the transport supply chains can be smoothly brought together in different transport areas.

articleTitle: Evaluating urban service economy gravitation and gravitational energy—Based on gravity model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper is devoted to introducing the notion of urban service economy gravitation and formulating service economy gravity model. Under specific traffic conditions, the developed model based on the conventional urban gravity model takes economic distance as the foundation, and the calculation of the model parameters are also discussed. With this backdrop, the model is applied to study Yangtze River Delta Megalopolis, which reveals the services economy gravitation and the gravitational energy between Shanghai and each other 15 cities.

articleTitle: A statistical control chart based on ARMA (n, n−1) model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this article, we apply the ARMA (n, n−1) model to the production system where there is some autocorrelation, and propose a new statistical control chart based on the model. The Monte Carlo Simulation is used to analyze the ability of the control chart. The results show that the ARMA (n, n−1) control chart significantly outperforms the ARMA (1, 1) one when the production process is stable; when facing unstable production process, ARMA (n, n−1) control chart can also have a good performance. Based on the results, we design the rules for choosing parameters and the procedure of constructing an ARMA (n, n−1) control chart.

articleTitle: Fundamental branches in investigation of linear functional differential equations
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: There are given a survey of author results in the theory of linear functional-differential equations that are based on the properties of Fredholm operator established by academician S. M. Nikol'skii in 1936-1943.

articleTitle: Energy-saving product innovative design process based on TRIZ/AD
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to direct industries to develop new energy saving product and to improve the energy efficiency of their products, an energy saving product innovative design process model based on TRIZ/AD is presented in this paper. This model is built based on TRIZ ideal final result driven innovative design framework. Integrated axiomatic design with the concept of energy saving and multiple objective decisions marking model to minimize energy consumption for the total product life cycle. A practical example of oil cylinder is provided to illustrate the validation of the model.

articleTitle: A two-phase optimization study on strategic alliance partners selection of collaborative product design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Directly related to the success of product design, selection of partners is an important element in collaborative design management technology. Based on the existing literature analysis, this paper proposed a set of more simple and practical selection steps according to the actual situation of partner selection. The proposed two stage partner selection method starts with the preliminary selection based on the improved effectiveness of DEA and then proceed to the optimization usage genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: A mission reliability method (MRM) for risk management in the development of materiel system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: There are two primary challenges in risk management in development of materiel: (1) The definition of the effect is dominant, which excessively relies on the engineering experience and lacks quantificational assessing methods; (2) There is no efficient way to distinguish cost, schedule and technical risk strictly, it is extremely difficult to evaluate their interrelated effects. This paper presents a new method named mission reliability method (MRM) to provide an innovative way to manage the risk in development materiel risk management. By employing both mission reliability block diagram (MRBD) and probabilistic technique, MRM can define the effect of risk events strictly. This is a mathematical way to identify, evaluate and control risk, and the analyzing results are a series of quantified risk indexes instead of a single one. The MRBD and amendatory mission reliability block diagram (AMRBD) are proposed to identify the reliability of the set of activity in development, to distinguish cost, schedule and technical risk clearly, of which each functional unit can be break down into appointed indenture level. The two above mentioned problems are effectively solved by MRM.

articleTitle: Based on Inter-enterprise collaborative product innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Nowadays violent competitive environment, many enterprises are facing the pressure that the product life cycle is increasingly shorter. Enterprises must develop new products constantly and put them to market quickly to meet changing market needs, so enterprises can remain competitive and share market in the same industry. This article describes traditional product development model and organizational structure, and analyzes its drawbacks; product design chain is a collaborative design network, which consists of manufacturers, suppliers and customers. Enterprises must conduct changes for organizational structure, if they want to integrate the resources of the members of the design chain effectively, and give full play to the innovative advantages of design chain. This article also described the feasibility and necessity of product development organizational innovation in the design chain management mode by the transaction cost theory perspective, and proposed design chain should have characteristics of organizational structure.

articleTitle: The reliability control model of CNC system based on concurrent engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The inherent reliability of product is determined by product design, but the traditional design method of reliability can not assure the higher requirements. In order to improve the reliability of CNC system fundamentally, the product development process of CNC system is improved and reconstructed by the idea of concurrent engineering in the article. The reliability work during its full-life-cycle is considered when it is designed. The reliability control model of CNC system based on concurrent engineering is put forward.

articleTitle: A study on the postponement investment decision-making of coal bed methane project based on the real options
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A large number of random factors in the process of the coal bed methane (CBM) development project can lead to a high degree of risk and uncertainties, and the traditional investment decision-making methods (for example DCF method) ignored the value of investment opportunities which were brought by the project environment's uncertainties and management flexibilities. Introducing real options method, we analyzes options' characteristics of CBM project in this paper, and constructed the investment decision-making model based on the postponement strategy, and illustrates the application of the model through case studies. So this paper provides new ideas and methods for investment decision-making of coal-bed methane project development.

articleTitle: Optimal queries processing in a heterogeneous sensor network using multicommodity network flow method
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In a wireless sensor network, it is a common practice to have in network partial data processing. As part of this, the mitigation of the demands issued by sink nodes in a heterogeneous resource constrained sensor network requires optimal resource sharing, which is a very challenging task. We find this task analogous to finding the optimal flow in a multi commodity flow network. The minimum cost multi commodity flow problem is an NP hard one. In our paper, we give an optimal cost algorithm to solve this problem where a special data structure is built, which we call Data Forwarding Tree. We compare our algorithm to a well known auction method where a commodity wins the bid based on the lowest cost path, and the other looser commodities are shipped using more expensive paths incurring more cost. An algorithmic analysis shows that our method is free of deadlock as well.

articleTitle: Analytic hierarchy process and Zhou-Yi tagging method for knowledge map navigation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Map navigation is a way of organizing the world's information geographically. Knowledge maps are used to visualize a set of related information. To solve problems of knowledge sharing and knowledge reusing in engineering domain, this paper propose a knowledge map navigation which is based on functional ontology and Zhou-Yi clustering.

articleTitle: Spatial-based decomposition approach for the crude scheduling problem of a refinery with multiple ports and long-distance pipelines
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This work addresses the large-scale crude scheduling problem of a real case refinery importing various types of crude oil from two ports via long-distance pipelines. We employ a spatial-based decomposition approach to construct a two-stage model of the practical refinery operations. During the first stage, the refinery plant is treated as a single aggregated demand node to simplify the port sub-problem. Specific receiving and charging operations of the plant sub-problem are then determined in the second stage. While the overall model of the refinery is difficult to solve, the decomposition approach could obtain satisfactory and flexible scheduling results with much less computational efforts.

articleTitle: The PSO-BP-based forecast of logistics cost for coal enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The forecast of logistics cost is the prerequisite and foundation for logistics cost management in coal enterprises. This paper has analyzed the logistics cost in coal enterprises and its influencing factors, using PSO-BP and BP network respectively to forecast the logistics cost in coal enterprises. As a result, it comes to a conclusion that the convergence speed and the predicted accuracy of PSO-BP network are obviously better than that of BP network.

articleTitle: Research the feasibility based on human factors in auto parts production line to improve the efficiency
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In our country, the productivity of auto parts production line is improved too much emphasis on equipment, technological innovation while ignoring human factors. Based on human factors theory, describing the people in the system operation characteristics, the optimization problem as the person's job to pursue an important objective, so that people who are working in this condition can be efficient, safe, healthy and comfortable. This paper has established a model to increase corporate productivity, and describes the specific implementation process, for enterprises to improve productivity and realistic significance.

articleTitle: Research on the National Compensation issues for the provincial highway construction
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The Highway consists of the roads used by vehicles and the other public infrastructure facilities around it that the lack of good management and the poor facilities usually causes the government compensation for damage. In order to solve these situations, we collected lots of cases in the study for conclusions. First, we divide the reasons into 6 categories. There are the factors in rock fall, bridge rupture, surface of road, gutter, trees beside the road, traffic signs and so on. Secondly, we suggest 6 categories of 18 actions to solve them. Nowadays to improve actions the government shall be limited by budget. However, the study uses the fuzzy AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Process, AHP) method to evaluate the actions priority. The frames of references are technology, policy, economy and 11 sub-references.

articleTitle: The life assessment of Complex System based on membership function
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Discussing a method of life assessment of Complex System. Firstly, based on the information fusion theory, considering the influence of unit life on the complex system, we transform life assessment into solving a fuzzy set. Secondly, we transform the membership solving into solving a regression equation, and calculate the parameter of two common distributions with the method of least square. Finally, we can solve the life model of the complex system. The result has been proved by MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: The value-relevance of fundamentals: Evidence from listed agribusiness firms in China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This research aims at assessing the value relevance of fundamentals in listed agribusiness firms in China. Due to the particularity of the agricultural industry, the quality of the fundamentals draws concern from investors and regulators, who have been questioning the trustworthiness of the fundamentals. In this paper, correlation between the accumulative abnormal returns and the unanticipated fundamentals is examined, and the Market Adjusted Return model is used for calculation of the accumulative abnormal returns and the Naïve model for calculation of the unanticipated fundamentals. Our evidence indicates that the fundamentals of the listed agribusiness firms in China have weak value relevance with very low R2 value. This paper also looks into causes for the weak value relevance of the fundamentals by analyzing the current Chinese accounting rules and the market efficiency and offers suggestions for further reform and improvement.

articleTitle: Dynamic modeling and characteristics analysis of the toroidal drive based on multibody of meshing rollers
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper first develops a mathematical model for the dynamic characteristics analysis of a toroidal drive. This model allows the analysis of a toroidal transmission with any numbers of planet worm gears distributed around the sun worm and any numbers of spherical rollers distributed around the planet-worm gear. In the modeling process, distinguished with other kind of gear transmission modeling, the planet-worm gear tooth (spherical roller) is considered as independent components in the toroidal drive system, the vibration modes are classified into planet-worm gear, spherical roller and translational modes. Further, the characteristics of the vibration amplitude and the Eigen-value number of different modes are analytically investigated.

articleTitle: An application of Fuzzy Optimal Cluster Model to the quality evaluation in logistics services
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As logistics belongs to the service industry, and the aim of logistics companies is to fulfill the satisfaction of customer. The quality evaluation for logistics service provides an objective basis for the logistics business to understand customer satisfaction degree, and to improve the service level. This paper firstly builds its evaluation indexes according to the current relatively common type of functional logistics services, then takes the case of a certain logistics company to collect data and take statistics though questionnaire survey and interviews to its customers, and finally makes a case study to its service quality according to the Fuzzy Optimal Cluster Model.

articleTitle: Research on simulation-based performance analysis of aero-engine casing production line
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Production line, taking on the most production task, is the important part in manufacturing enterprise. Under determinate resource, the running state of the production line has a great impact on the production capacity. This paper, aiming the aero-engine casing production line, makes a systematic study on production line simulation, builds the model of aero-engine casing production line, and makes analysis and optimization on the simulation results. A product-delivery-oriented simulation optimization method is proposed. The target function model based on an improved PSO algorithm is introduced to optimize the production scheduling.

articleTitle: Risk evaluation of EPC project based on ANP fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to assess and analyze the importance of the elements which have a significant impact on the risk, analytic network process is applied to establish the network structure model of risk evaluation index system for EPC project. And hypermatrix is utilized to compute and determine the weight of all the indexes. An EPC project risk evaluation model is constructed based on ANP (Analytic Network Process) -Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation to evaluate the integrated risk level. Validity of such EPC project risk evaluation model would be proved by a demonstration case analysis with help of Super Decision software. Results are shown at the last part of this paper.

articleTitle: An data exchange methodology of CAD and virtual assembly system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Obtaining data from CAD system is the first step for virtual assembly system to verify the rationality of design. A feature-based integrated product model in virtual assembly system is a hierarchical information model and can be presented by polygon layer, B-Rep layer, feature layer and so on. Reconstruction method from CAD to virtual assembly system was proposed for information translation. An integration methodology by using XML-based neural file and triangle polygon model file, translation is completed and information contained in the model is transformed. The solution provides data share very well.

articleTitle: Research on the early-warning model based on the controllable degrees of alarm
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the past, when alarming for the accident, only the relative emergency plan are launched according to the diagnosed warning degree, without considering the controllable of the warning root and the controllable degrees of alarm. However, these factors shall affect the early-warning effects and the level of the emergency plan. Towards this situation, the extension theory is applied in this paper to diagnose the warning degree and the controllable degree, analyze the controllable conditions of the warning root, and launch the relevant alarming plan. Not only the accuracy and strong degree of the emergency plan is well diagnosed, but also the tracking of the emergency plan is improved. Finally, the further loss caused by the delayed risk consequences are solved.

articleTitle: Study on construction enterprise's transnational cooperation based on core competence in value chain
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Transnational cooperation can realize the internationalization strategy of the construction enterprise and bring about various advantages. Transnational cooperation in core competence relies on the evolutionary game playing analysis between migrant construction enterprise and local enterprise. Based on the identification of core competence in the value chain of the construction enterprise, this paper takes technical competence for example, to investigate the influence factors and decision state by analyzing the evolutionary mechanism in transnational technical cooperation, and extends the investigation into other competence, in hope of offering the theoretical basis for research on transnational cooperation of construction enterprises.

articleTitle: Economic Efficiency Analysis of Energy Efficiency retrofit for existing residential building in Tangshan, China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Energy efficiency retrofit for existing residential buildings is facing a fast development in China. As the first set demonstrative buildings of the Sino-German “Chinese existing Building Energy Efficiency Improvement” project, economic efficiency analysis has been made in this paper. The scheme and cost of Hebei No.1 Residential Quarter are summarized in this paper. Heating energy consumption of demonstrative buildings has been calculated. The results show that the payback period of this retrofit project of demonstrative buildings is more than the building life, and its cost is higher than the average cost of investment for energy efficiency retrofit for existing residential buildings.
