Therefore, the reasons for high cost of the demonstrative buildings are discussed. The conclusions may be meaningful for energy efficiency retrofit project in China.

articleTitle: The improved genetic algorithm for the complex job-shop scheduling
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Job shop scheduling problem is a typical NP-hard problem, most of the existing researches of job-shop scheduling have the following problems: firstly, took various processing parameters of the production systems as the exact uncertainty value; Secondly, took production system as a static system, ignored a variety of unexpected situations of the actual processing. This paper started from the actual demand of production operation and management of complex production environment, taking non-deterministic exact value, disturbance and other factors of the processing parameters in the production process into account, carried out the job-shop scheduling research question of a complex production environment based on improved genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Feasibility analysis of carbon taxes of China based on Environmental Kuznets Curve (EKC)
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the global warming, how to reduce greenhouse gas emissions of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mainly has become the focus of global discussion. Many economists proposed that if carbon tax is imposed according to the carbon content of traditional fossil fuel used in production, it will reduce carbon dioxide emissions. In fact, some countries have started to practice. The paper uses Environmental Kuznets Curve (EKC) to analyze factors of China's carbon emissions and do further assessing on the feasibility analysis of carbon taxes.

articleTitle: Modeling for design chain optimization based on information flow
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As a special supply chain, design chain is the development trend for product research and development. Compared with supply chain, there is mainly product design and development information in design chain. In order to improve information sharing, modified method of IDEF0v, which is often used in construction design field, is applied to the design chain relationship modeling among design operations. In view of design chain's characteristics, such as multi-tenant, multi-tasking, multi-product mix, and multi-parameter, four types DSM are integrated and design structure matrix set (DSMS) is proposed to construct information model of design chain. From optimizing information feedback, a mathematical model is presented to optimize the design operation order.

articleTitle: The forecasting model's establish and analyze of the demand of traveling between mini-three links
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The mini-three links has become the most important transportation mode for the Taiwan's businessmen of traveling between Taiwan and China. Therefore, to develop the mini-three links' forecasting model can provide the traveling information of mini-three links to the air carriers, it would be helpful for the air carriers to devise operation plan. This study will combine ARIMA model and backpropagation neural network (BNN) of Artificial intelligence, which just developed recent years, to apply to forecasting mini-three links' traveling requirement and establish suitable forecasting model. Through mean square error (MSE) and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) measure forecasting achievement found out that the result of combine ARIMA and BNN mode is superior to individual forecasting mode of ARIMA and BNN. As a result, to combine ARIMA and BNN mode to set the forecasting of traveling between mini-three links is very accurate.

articleTitle: A new authorization model of a case-based complex system applied in enterprise informatization
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper focuses on the design of authorization module, which serves as one of key links in the developing process of enterprise information management system. Combining the results of foreign literature and practice, the paper starts with the analysis and comparison on three commonly used authorization model, and then proceeds to the development background introduction of enterprise authorization system, which is example-based. An improved authorization model relying on one single authorization table in a complex system is introduced according to the original organizational structure. The classification levels of subjects and objects are redesigned, and the characteristics of GUID data type are brought into full play correspondingly.

articleTitle: Application of gray relative analysis method in the market segment alternatives of auto components
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the increasingly keen competition of automobile market, the auto component enterprises pay more and more attention to the market segment alternatives, in order to suit the demand of market. Market segment is the important step of the alternatives of target market, and the key factor related to the success of the enterprises. Thus it becomes an important assignment the enterprises face to scientifically evaluate the comprehensive performance of the market segment of automobile components. Based on the large amount of indefinite and fuzzy factors involved in the course of market segment, the paper applies gray relative analysis method into the analysis about the alternative results of the market segment, and establishes scientific evaluation system of market segment, which supplies a quantitative approach for the market segment of auto replacements enterprise and carries out empirical analysis.

articleTitle: Role of education for spillover effects of FDI on innovation in China: Evidence from the 1998–2008 provincial panel data
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Foreign direct investment (FDI) can benefit innovation activity in the host country via spillover channels. However, it may also cause negative effects because of the absorptive capacity of the host country. To analyze the absorptive capacity of the host country, experts usually put their attentions on the level of R&D investment. This paper focused on the role of education on spillover effects of FDI. Using provincial panel data from 1998 to 2008, we found spillover effects of FDI on innovation in China are influenced by the level of education investment. Different kinds of education investment plays different role on FDI spillover effects. China needs to improve the education system and speed up the education reform.

articleTitle: On integrated production model based on TOC
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper represents the origin and main content of the Theory of Constraints, and summarizes its principles for production planning and control, and discusses the necessity and validity for enterprises integrating production model by introducing TOC combined with the fact of enterprises' operation, and then puts forward an efficient model.

articleTitle: Effective components sourcing management; perspective of export processing in China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Numerous global manufacturing firms use China as their manufacturing platform and are engaged in processing trade for global markets. They are engaged in export processing operation through the form of processing with supplied materials(PSM) and processing with purchased materials(PPM). The major goal of this paper is to explore, from the perspective of export processing in China, the key characteristics of PSM and PPM mode supply chain, and investigate the driving factors influencing foreign MNCs to choose appropriate processing types for effective components sourcing management. Through case study this paper suggests that components sourcing capability, products characteristics, overall operational capability and business environment in China may influence the choice of PSM or PPM.

articleTitle: Research of regional water utilization strategy based on water footprint theory
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the conditions that there is a serious lack of regional water resources and unreasonable utilization, the water footprint theory is proposed for regional water studies, some related concepts such as blue water, green water, virtual water and water footprint deficit are introduced, utilization of water resources as well as the actual distribution of water resources are shown through water footprint, it's understood that either conventional water-saving strategy or the virtual water trade can be taken to solve the problem of regional water resources shortage through water footprint calculation and analysis, strategies like establishment of regular monitoring and warning mechanism, and safeguards like management mechanism, laws and standards mechanisms are proposed in order to keep the regional balance of water footprint and provide a theoretical support the sustainable use of regional water resources.

articleTitle: A hybrid local search approach in solving the Mirrored Traveling Tournament Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Scheduling for modern professional sports leagues has drawn considerable attention in recent years in that their practical applications involve significant revenues and generate challenging combinatorial optimization problems. The Traveling Tournament Problem is a sports scheduling problem that abstracts the important issues in creating time tables: feasibility and team travel, where the objective is to minimize the total distance traveled by the teams. In this paper, we tackle the mirrored version of this problem. First, an effective and comprehensive constructive algorithm is applied which quickly obtains initial solution at a very high quality. Then a hybrid local search approach was proposed based on the combination of Tabu Search and Variable Neighborhood Descent meta-heuristic, together with Greedy Randomized Adaptive Search Procedure, which explores large neighborhood with various and effective moves. Very competitive solutions are obtained for benchmark instances within a reasonable amount of time compared with previous results in the literature.

articleTitle: Improved genetic algorithm for solving the fuzzy multiobjective Job Shop problem
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studies the influence of the encoding and decoding on the result of the Job Shop problem under E/T indicators and improve the coding methods to make the optimal object span in order to adapt to different delivery windows earliness / tardiness scheduling problem. In this paper, The trapezoidal fuzzy number which has more representation as flexible operating processing time under fuzzy environment was used. Multi-attribute decision making method based on possibility was used. In this way it can reduce the intermediate process, avoid the loss of information, and enhance the effectiveness of fuzzy evaluation. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on safety evaluation of coal mine airflow system based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In coal mine production logistics there are many random factors that result the characters of complexity, non-linear and uncertain of production system. But traditional safety evaluation methods rely on subjective experience, and have a lower evaluating precision. Artificial neural network has better nonlinear mapping ability and high learning ability, which overcomes the deficiencies. Therefore, BP neural network is utilized to establish a safety evaluation model of coal mine airflow system. Firstly, based on the knowledge of coal mine airflow system build an evaluation index system, secondly select reasonable samples of coal mine airflow system as training samples, adjust parameters and add momentum gradient for a better convergence speed, then after a large number of training select the best training network as an evaluation model. Finally, present the application of this model through case analysis, also give reasonable suggestions for coal mine safety production.

articleTitle: Coastal zone urban ecological economy evaluation based on SFA and factor analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, we first established the coastal urban ecological economic development index system. Then using factor analysis and stochastic frontier approach, the coastal zone urban ecological economy input-output efficiency was analyzed. The results could provide theory basis for coastal urban ecological economic development research.

articleTitle: A coordinating mechanism of inventory network in supply-driven chain
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Supply-driven chain is different from demand- driven supply chain, because of its initiative to meet the user needs to gain better dynamic performances. The conception and characteristics of supply-driven chain are discussed here, and then the network topology model of its inventory system. Two aspects of inventory coordination are analyzed here, including both the horizontal coordination between suppliers or manufacturers, and the vertical coordination between suppliers and manufacturers, or between manufacturers and retailers/end users, to fit the user demand forwardly.

articleTitle: Delivery time oriented collaborative production based on multi-agent
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Given problems existing in the on-time delivery of manufacturing enterprises, this article, with an analysis of factors affecting on-time delivery and internal order processing flow, puts forward a delivery-time-oriented collaborative production model. According to the complexity of order processing and workshop scheduling, and based on the features of being autonomous and collaborative of multi-agent systems, the framework structure and functional classification of delivery-time-oriented collaborative production system are established. A case study of the application of the system is introduced. The result shows that the time of delivery is shortened, which proves the feasibility of the delivery-time-oriented collaborative production system.

articleTitle: Cooperative Supply Chain management using a Grid-based optimizer
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A cooperative supply chain seeks to coordinate its members to produce and distribute products along the chain, for minimum overall costs to satisfy customer demand. An integrated multi-period, multiple product and multiple stage supply chain is formulated using a flow networks framework. A Cooperative Supply Chain Optimizer (CSCO), as a central software entity taking advantage of Grid technology, connects and gathers necessary operational information from members of the corporate supply chain. The CSCO then guides supply chain members on ordering decisions, for a minimum overall cost of the entire supply chain, while continuously re-directing the members as new data becomes available. The system has been implemented in a cooperative supply chain, with a diverse and dynamic set of member systems connecting to the Grid, with an approximately 26% reduction in total costs of the supply chain.

articleTitle: Invest project risk assessment based on joint entropy model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In recent years, the study of sensitivity analysis most lay emphasis on linear analysis methods, without taking into account the nonlinear characteristics of the various uncertainties factors, and only consider sensitivity entropy is not enough, that the probability is another side. this paper makes a comprehensive analysis of the investment projects risk factors sensitive entropy and risk occurrence probability entropy to determine the joint entropy of the right for the investment project evaluation index, it builds up a sensitivity analyze model and probability analyze model to get the joint entropy in random environments. In the end, it also supplies a multi-scheme evaluation decision- making model.

articleTitle: Research on selecting the credit evaluation indexes to the project managers in construction enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Evaluation index system is the basis of evaluating the credit of project managers in construction enterprises. To evaluate the credit of project managers in construction enterprises scientifically and normatively, the affecting elements of the project manager's credit was comprehensively analyzed, and by analyzing the subjection and correlativity of the indexes according to the sample data, the qualitative and quantitative credit evaluation index system was finally established based on the characteristics of construction project management. There is some directive significance on the credit evaluation of project managers for construction enterprises and credit rating organizations.

articleTitle: Condition-based early stage diagnosis robust ant colony clustering algorithm and feature mapping
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Performance evaluation is crucial to increasing equipment availability and reliability as well as facilitating further proactive maintenance. This paper presents a novel condition-based early stage diagnosis method using robust ant colony clustering algorithm and feature mapping. Vibration signals acquired from equipments are decomposed by wavelet packet transform after wavelet denoising, and then feature measures based on frequency bands are extracted by ant colony clustering algorithm to form an input vector for training performance evaluation model. Operating conditions of equipment are predicted using feature mapping. Furthermore, a robust ant colony clustering algorithm is proposed to adjust comparison probability dynamically. Finally, effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method are verified by vibration signals acquired from a drilling test bed.

articleTitle: Research on reform and development model for rural urbanization of Xiamen suburbs
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Rural urbanization is a relief for the thirst for urban construction land in the course of existing urban expansion and, on the other hand, unavoidably results in the expropriation of massive farmers' land, this will definitely shake the public stability and unity if the farmers' legal rights are left unprotected, and only reasonably-designed reform and development model as well as establishment of long-acting mechanism for life guarantee of farmers involved could assure smooth urbanization. Through the design and analysis of reform and development model in the rural urbanization of Xiamen suburbs, this article brings out the design principles of the reform and development model, seeks for a final reform and development model that better meets with the requirements for human orientation and sustainable development and points out a relatively new way of research for the win-win development between the government and villagers involved.

articleTitle: Virtual value chain and competitive advantages in the context of e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The Internet has change traditional firms' operation management and business model, which makes Porter's traditional value chain need to be improved. In this paper, we consider virtual value chain to be a new tool for analyzing and creating competitive advantages in the context of e-commerce. In this study, the shortages of traditional physical value chain (PVC) based on marketplace were discussed, and then the theory of virtual value chain (VVC) on the marketspace is introduced. We developed a model of firms' virtual value chain in the context of e-commerce, and addressed the information model of the VVC. Then we combined the VVC and Porter's two types of competitive advantages, and found that a firm can achieve both cost-leading and differentiation advantages by exploiting virtual value chain.

articleTitle: An integrated location-inventory model for vendor-managed inventory in the retail supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Supply chain management involves multiple and conflicting objectives. A multi-objective optimization procedure which permits a trade-off evaluation for an integrated location-inventory model is initially presented. In this paper, we propose an integrated model to incorporate inventory control decisions - such as economic order quantity, safety stock and inventory replenishment decisions under vendor-managed inventory collaborative initiative - into typical facility location models, which are used to solve the distribution network design problem. This model includes elements of total cost, customer service and flexibility as its objectives. Moreover, a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm is developed to determine the optimal facility location portfolio in order to reach best compromise of these conflicting criteria. A hybrid evolutionary approach is proposed and its scenario analysis is implemented on a real large retail supply chain in Taiwan to investigate the model performance and to illustrate how parameter changes influence its output. Some preliminary results are described.

articleTitle: Investigation and analysis of organizational capital and technology innovation in Chinese enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The status of organizational capital, tacit knowledge transfer and technology innovation were investigated based on the investigation of domestic equipment-manufacturing enterprises. The impact of organizational capital, tacit knowledge transfer on technology innovation were analyzed by empirical data, the difference of technology innovation between enterprises at different levels of organizational capital and tacit knowledge transfer were identified, and then issues in investigation were discussed. The result is useful for enterprises to recognize the relationship between organizational capital and technology innovation, and also provides theoretical support for the technology innovation practice.

articleTitle: R&D investment valuation in growth option under incomplete information
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A lot of previous studies have manifested that the investment of research and development (R&D) can be evaluated by growth option approach. The growth option as well as the R&D investment, has three significant characteristics: the uncertainty of project value, the uncertainty of investment cost and information cost. The main contribution of this paper was constructing a more general model to evaluate R&D investment considering the three characteristics simultaneously. Sensitivity analyses were also presented to separately illustrate the dynamic relationships between the growth option value and the project value, the growth option value and investment cost, and the growth option value and information cost. Hopefully, the purpose of this study is providing another alternative for managers to help them evaluate R&D investment better.

articleTitle: Economic efficiency evaluation of national economic development zones based on DEA and SFA
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Considering comprehensively of the actual development of the national economic and technological development zones in China and the availability of the evaluation data, the paper used data envelopment analysis (DEA) and stochastic frontier analysis (SFA) to evaluate the economic efficiency of China's national development zones with different input and output indicators. The article had come up the economic efficiency ranking of different national economic development zones. Finally, the results of analysis is evaluated detailed and the strategies and recommendations of increasing the efficiency of economic and technological development zones are proposed.

articleTitle: Logistics Systems Function Deployment Model for Construction Project and application
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To improve the quality of logistics service is considered to be the preferred method to hold the customer. From the sight of Systemism, project logistics service is a complicated systems engineering with non-repeatability, systemic, risk, planned, high performance technologies and other features. For such a complex system, we need to build simulation model from system structure to refinement the overall service to “Behavior scale” of system work and achieve the function deployment of system through WBS. Logistics Systems Function Deployment Model for Construction Project was established. The model is proved more validity and effective through work anti-jamming analysis and service satisfaction inquisition by using positive analysis.

articleTitle: Effective language policy within global communication
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the age of globalization which broadly means international interaction, the idea of global communication comes to the front. Communicating globally implies using intercultural links and involves cultural knowledge of business counterparts as an integral part of global interaction. Language media being an essential tool of global interaction facilitate the process of business communication provided that certain guidelines are taken into consideration.

articleTitle: Applying quality function deployment to quality management of product service system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Quality management of product service system (PSS) should not only consider product quality but also service quality. Product quality and service quality is so different that PSS quality management is difficult. The purpose of this paper is to propose an efficacious method for PSS quality management. QFD is a structured method in which customer requirements are translated into appropriate technical requirements for each stage of product and service provision, it has been widely used in production and service respectively. Basing on the PSS blueprint, five stages QFD method has been propose to quality management of PSS. The point work in QFD application is defining whats and hows. Whats include convenience, reliability, responsiveness, empathy and tangibility, while hows is composed of product design, product line design, channel system, recovery system, staff training.

articleTitle: Genetic algorithm for Job Shop Scheduling with Earliness and Tardiness penalties
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The just-in-time production philosophy has led to a growing interest in scheduling problems considering both Earliness and Tardiness (E/T) penalties. An E/T schedule model, with the consideration of different penalties for tardiness, earliness and flowtime of jobs, is introduced to minimize total production costs. Based on classical genetic algorithm, a new Enhanced Genetic Algorithm (EGA) is designed to solve tardy and early problems. In order to avoid infeasible decoding solutions and reduce simultaneously tardiness costs, the chromosome-repair operator based on critical paths is put forward to solve the problem that some jobs violate the due date constraints. The objective-value revision operator based on chromosome rescheduling is introduced to reduce in-process and final goods inventory costs by delaying job release date. The proposed approaches have been tested on a wide range of 80 scheduling problems and satisfactory results have been obtained.

articleTitle: Constructing green supply chain based on the mode of circulation economy
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Circulation economy is a form of economic organization through the integration of industrial chains,to achieve re-use, multiple use, and recycling. The green supply chain is a kind of modern green logistic model that through minimum resource input to reach the highest efficiency and maximum recycling, to realize the coordinated development of economy and ecology at the idea of circular economy and sustainable development. Based on this, starting from the theory of circulation economy and expounding the connotation and the content of green supply chain to point out that circulation economy engenders the green supply chain, and then through studying on characteristics and system structure of green supply chain based on the mode of circulation economy, analyzes the constructing of green supply chain from the aspects of enterprise and government.

articleTitle: The analysis of ecological footprint of Tianjin
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper applied the basic theory and the method of the ecological footprint, based on the date of Tianjin statistical bureau, 2001-2006, calculated the ecological footprint, the ecological carrying capacity and the ecological deficit of Tianjin from 2001 to 2006. The results indicated that: with the ecological footprint continually increasing, the ecological was also rapidly increased, from 2001 it had risen from 1.575 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/cap to 2.002 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/cap in 2006, this demonstrated that the ecological deficit of Tianjin was serious, Tianjin was far from sustainable development.

articleTitle: An information fusion method for reliability based on D-S evidential theory
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The multi-source reliability information fusion method based on D-S evidential theory is presented in this paper to solve the complex system reliability assessment problems. Aimed to the multi-source reliability information, the method in this paper established basic probability assignment firstly. Then, the reliability information is fused using D-S evidential theory. After that, the fused basic probability assignment is translated into a bet probability distribution function based on the pignistic probability transformation method. At last, the comprehensive reliability assessment is obtained.

articleTitle: Study on system of research team collaborative eco-efficiency in Yunnan biological industry
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper first analyzed the characteristics of collaborative research in biological industry, and defined research team collaborative eco-efficiency according to the perspective of sustainable development. Second, proposed the corresponding metrics as following: (1)Completion efficient of the project; (2) Quantity and quality of results; (3)The contribution force on technological innovation; (4)The degree of enhance of scientific research ability; (5)Teamwork cooperation satisfaction; (6) Reasonable use of funds, etc. Third, a systematic architecture of sustainable development capacity of research team was presented. Finally, proposed some problem that is worthy to study in later, to explore the effective way to improve technological innovation of major bio-industry in Yunnan.

articleTitle: Systematic strategies in design process for innovative product development
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To shorten products development time, increase products quality, reduce cost and meet the requirements of customers have become the crucial issue in today's enterprises competition. There are many design control strategies to evaluate all possible issues and avoid the time and cost waste from improper design. In this research, QFD (Quality Function Deployment) is as the infrastructure and AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Process) is to measure the relative importance weights of product requirements. Then, QFD results transfer customer' requirements to engineering parameters in TRIZ (Theory of Inventive Problem Solving). After all rules of concept design have been deployed, the products can be proved by applying FMEA (Failure Mode and Effect Analysis) for reliable analysis. Finally, an example of the design process of safety catch mechanism in the pneumatic staple gun is implemented to explain these design strategies for the product development process.

articleTitle: The transaction cost-saving model of supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper aim to propose a transaction cost-saving model that provides effective guidance in the early stages of supply chain management (SCM). Explaining the description of existing prescriptive definitions for transaction cost (TC) and signaling game theory based on literature review. According to the investigations of TC-prohibitive problem for a case example of NOKIA Mobile parts suppliers, indicating substantial improvement by reducing the number of providers and reallocating them to the markets. This model would help a decision maker to resolve the issues related to selection of suppliers under a set of conflicting multi-objective criteria.

articleTitle: Application of reverse auction in the supplier selection
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper analyzed the shortage of the existing method of supplier selection and introduced the reverse auction in it. The technique avoided the deficiency of the existing method and the supplier had more opportunity to revelation its preponderance thus the supplier selection was not unilateral and it could greatly reduce the stock price. The results obtained from the application of this method to the supplier selection indicate that this method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Impact of investment and technology stock on total production: An empirical study of 35 cities in China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to evaluate the impact of investment and technology stock on total production, a panel date model is used in this paper. By introducing investment in fixed assets as investment's proxy, estimation of the number of in-force issued patents from 30 provincial capitals and 5 cities specially designated in the state plan as technology stock's proxy, the paper model can solve the problem of parameter quantification. Empirical results show that the investment and technology stock have positive impact on the total production, that the elasticity coefficient of investment is more than that of technology stock, that the total factor productivity(TFP) of the western cities is less than that of eastern coastal cities. Not only investment in fixed assets and innovation should be increased, but also the total factor productivity should be be increased in the process of Western Development.

articleTitle: Simulation and multi-agent-based integrated solution for manufacturing planning and control
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The performance level of customer services (for example, short time for delivery of customer orders and economical service process) in manufacturing enterprises greatly depends on an effective manufacturing planning and control system (MPCS). The hierarchical planning approach of most MPCS may have resulted in critical situations, such as rigidity in the planning structure, complex control system design, and inflexible process. Applying a negotiation-based decision-making approach, also known as multi-agent approach (MAS), can help a distributed and autonomous system to perform successfully. However, in this scenario, each of the agents is applied to the system with an individual objective, thereby leading to conflicts between individual objectives and performance of the entire system. Therefore, this research aims for an agent-based manufacturing planning and control system (AMPCS) by developing an effective closed-loop feedback simulation (CLFS) algorithm.

articleTitle: Research and application of process information integrated system based on Web technology
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to provide better information support and services for manufacturing informationalization, and provide technical information services for the process design, process information decision, manufacturing process modeling and simulation and product information management, etc., in the product manufacturing process, by using Web technology, database technology, modeling and simulation technology and intelligent decision technology, an process information integration system based on B/S three-layer network architecture was researched and developed, which includes four subsystems, process resource management system, process information management system, process modeling and simulation system and process decision system. Product process information was taken as a kernel in this system. Then, process integrated model oriented to product was built, and a number of enterprise aid decision making systems were developed based on the general management of enterprise process information. Besides, the system architectures, functions, characteristics and key implementation technologies were introduced in detail.

articleTitle: An empirical study of full-circulating stock's IPO underpricing in China's A-share market
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In China, IPO underpricing phenomena attracts more and more attentions. This paper constructs a structural system of equations and uses the instrumental-variables method to analyze IPO underpricing of the full-circulating stocks. Our empirical findings that those IPO underpricing and initial turnovers are negatively correlated support the hypothesis of speculative bubbles. The IPO underpricing is negatively correlated with earnings per share (EPS), and positively correlated with price-earning (PE) ratio, which suggests some irrationality of A-share market investors.

articleTitle: Research on knowledge management of e-maintenance alliance
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Under the e-maintenance pattern, knowledge share among the members of equipment maintenance alliance is very important. In order to manage the knowledge of equipment maintenance alliance effectively, the knowledgement structure and its characteristics were analyzed. On the basis of the process of equipment maintenance knowledge analyze, the cooperative maintenance of equipment network and knowledge share mode were introduced. Furthermore, the knowledge growth model of each member and the whole alliance were built in quantity.

articleTitle: Friction measurements on inclined dry, wet, and glycerol-contaminated floors using four footwear samples
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Slips and falls are very common not only in industry but also in our daily activities. The coefficient of friction (COF) is coomonly adopted as a measure to quantify floor slipperiness and as an index to represent the risk of slipping and falling. A friction measurement study was conducted in the laboratory under four footwear, three surface, and three inclination conditions. The Brungraber Mark II slipmeter was used for the measurement. The results showed that all the main and interaction effects of the three factors were statistically significant. Dry floors had the highest COF, next with the wet floor, and finally the glycerol contaminated floors. The flat floor had the highest COF, next with the 5° floors, and finally the 10° ones. Treaded Neolite had better slip-resistance than flat Neolite. Treaded rubber, however, did not provided batter slip-resistance than that of the flat rubber sample.

articleTitle: Electric power engineering bidding evaluation based on C2R model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper leads the application of DEA (data envelopment analysis) into the power engineering bidding estimation practices. The scheme of evaluation carrying out multi-IO indices helps weaken the influence of subjective factor in the power engineering bidding evaluation. The paper builds up the power engineering bid evaluation index system, and in this foundation, it evaluates and analyzes the relative efficiency of the tender schemes. Finally the paper provides advice to the decision-maker with the efficiency information of different scheme in terms of different IO index-combination system.

articleTitle: A study of combined manual materials handling tasks under footwear and lifting and lowering height conditions
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A study on combined manual materials handling tasks performed on floors under three footwear and four lifting and lowering height conditions. Twelve male subjects participated in the study. The maximum acceptable weight of handling, including lifting, carrying for 3 m, lowering, and walking 3 m back at 2 per minute was determined. The subject then performed the same tasks for 10 minutes. The VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, heart rate, and rating of perceived exertion for whole body strain were measured. The results showed that the effects of footwear on the maximum acceptable weights of handling (MAWH), heart rate, and VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> were not significant. The effects of lifting and lowering height on all dependent variables except rating of perceived exertion were statistically significant (p≤0.027). Lifting from the floor and lowering on the floor condition was the most stressful condition than all other lifting and lowering condition. The subjects had the lowest MAWH on this condition. In addition, lifting from the floor and lowering on the floor condition resulted in the highest physiological responses including both VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and heart rate. The effects of lifting and lowering height on RPE was, however, not significant. The implication of this study was that lifting and lowering height should be regarded as one of the major job factors in designing MMH tasks as it affected physiological responses of the subjects. This is consistent with the findings in the literature.

articleTitle: Design of mining drawing management system based on workflow model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: For Manual management of mining drawings, cycle of designing and approval is difficult to control, and document management is a tedious task. Based on workflow technology for mining drawings, this paper analyzed business processes of mining drawings in the full life cycle, established a mining drawing dynamic management model and defined transfer processes of mining drawings. Four kinds of transition structures on workflow engine reflected connections and constraint relations among various activities during the transfer of mining drawings. Finally, this paper discussed the system's overall structure and the compositions of function modules, and described realization methods of the key technical details. The site application showed that the system realized the automation of process management in the full life cycle of mining drawings and improved the working efficiency.

articleTitle: A HASS profile research method based on computer simulation technology
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To identify and eliminate the product's early failures with the lowest cost and the best effect, this paper proposes a HASS profile research method based on computer simulation technology. Firstly, the flow and implement steps are introduced, then take the solder joint as an example, to show the application of the computer simulation method in a specific way, finally, summarizes the application prospect of the method. Through the method above, the manufacturer' cost would be saved as well as their competitiveness would be improved.

articleTitle: Strategic study on China construction industrial market based on SSCP: An example
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Construction industry plays a key role in Chinese national economy. It provides material foundation for continuous development both in national economy and in people's life, and is the only road for the transformation from fixed industrial investment to practical productivity and value. With the accelerating economy development, China steps into the transformation period from traditional planned economy system to market system. Taking specific economic and political factors into account, some forms of the old system unsuitable to the market system will be broken down gradually and the other forms can be maintained. Of course, it is a competitive process. The transformation period is a reconstruction time and will last for a long time. From the view of industry development, the construction industrial organization has a long way to be reasonable, while the traditional analysis framework and basic conclusion are established by the basic assumption of perfect free market and private ownership of property. Hence, there exists a certain limitation to analyze the transformation period for China construction industrial organization. In this work, under the Market Structure & Property Structure - Enterprise Conduct - Market Performance (SSCP) analysis framework, China construction industrial market performance during the transformation period has been discussed. The analytical results will be helpful for the maneuverable strategies and have important theoretical and practical significance for prompting the process of China industrial organization optimization and strengthening construction industrial market performance.

articleTitle: Technological innovation path based on niche strategy: The case of BEIFA in china
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Niche strategy takes some narrow business scope as starting point, through concentrating the input of resources and expanding market scope, finally become leading position in dominant market. The paper selected Ningbo BEIFA Group as example, and summarized the innovation modes, processes and approaches based on niche strategy. The paper shows that the technology innovation process of BEIFA can be divided into three stages: entering into niche market, occupying niche market, and global development. It has been managed in pen making segment market since its foundation and adopted operation strategy about “a big market with small commodities and mass production for small commodities”, constructed innovation ability through innocuous interaction between market extension and technology capacity growth and finally became the largest domestic pen making enterprise. Through the analysis, the paper argues that other enterprises can apply niche strategy to form core technology ability and build up enterprise brand.

articleTitle: The expectation disparity of cost control and cost utility optimization in supply chain management context
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Supply chain management is ultimately charactering the complementation of economic process now and future. Those not only promote the trend of high gradation of cost system and the differences of cost utilities that determined by supply chain operations, but also eliminate the effectiveness of traditional cost control, which based on cost-saving and money-grubbing consciousness. Therefore, On the basis of a review and notarizing of traditional cost theories, this paper examines the origin and properties of the expectation disparity of traditional cost theory and its theoretic tendencies in supply chain management context, and Its conclusion puts forward a suggestion for optimising cost systems and eliminating disparity in modern economies.

articleTitle: Analysis on coastal zone ecological economy system based on integrated regulations
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The coastal zone ecological economy system is facing a serious stress due to the rapid economic development and increased resource demand like substantial land-based pollutant discharged into the sea and unreasonable development. Using the regular integrated method, we established a coastal zone ecological economy system stress model and analyzed the influencing factors.

articleTitle: A hybrid due-date fulfilled forecasting based on clustering and decision trees
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In wafer fabrication, due date fulfilling is very important. How to timely delivering the goods to customer is very important. It will enhance customer service and competitive advantage. But the complexities of production system and re-entrant processes in wafer fabrication have raised the challenge for due date management. How to predict due date related performance is very important. In this research, a predict model of due date related performance based on decision tree has been modeled. Due date fulfilling performance will be classified to EE (extremely earliness), NE (Normal earliness), OT (On time), NL (Normal lateness), EL (Extremely lateness) based on the decision tree trained by a great quantity of historical data. Furthermore, different combination of order releasing rules (UNIF, TB, and WR) and dispatching rules (FIFO, EDD, CR, SRPT, and COVERT) have been considered in the simulation tests. In the result of simulation and statistics, average rate of correctly classifying is more than 90%. Especially in the combination of TB*SRPT, UNIF*COVERT, and WR*COVERT, the rate are larger than 95%. Managers of the wafer fabrication plants can improve the decision quality for due date management and shop floor control by prediction the due date related performance.

articleTitle: SMEs cluster resource integration capability classification based on SOM neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: An evaluation index system of resource integration capability for SMEs clusters is established based on the resource-based and capability-based views. A classification model for resource integration capability is constructed based on SOM (Self-Organizing Feature Map) neural network. An example is given to illustrate the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A study of reputation measurement system of construction agency in government investment project
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The trusting and cooperative relation between government principal and Construction Agency (CA) which based on the reputation effect from repeated game of principal and agent is a long-term incentive mechanism in government investment project. The importance of reputation effect is increasing in the construction agency competition, and the selection of CA based on reputation need an effective measurement of the reputation for CA. The paper analyzed components and driving factors of CA reputation, establishing CA reputation measurement indexes system and model from the view of stakeholders. However the measurement indexes should need further empirical study. Only by this the reputation evaluations can be introduced into CA Market Access management in order to establish a kind of cooperative relation in CA market and make it more perfect.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between R&D input and patent output in Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The number of patents applying is an important indicator of the technological level of a region. The most fundamental factor that influences the number of patents applying is the R&D input. With the Granger causality test, this study verified the causality between the R&D input and patent output in Hebei Province in the case of the full-time equivalent of R&D personnel with one year lag for the patent output and the R&D expenditures with two years lag for the patent output. Further, based on the Cobb-Douglas production function, the theoretical model for the relationship between the R&D input and the patent output was established, and the correlation of the R&D input and innovation output in Hebei Province was analyzed. For the status quo in Hebei, relevant policies and recommendations were proposed in the study to intensify the R&D input and improve the efficiency of the R&D input.

articleTitle: Research in application methods of production line balancing at automobile paint shops
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Most of the modern manufacturing industry is operating upon a continuous production line with numerous working processes, while the time of each process can not be identical either in theory or in reality. The working load is bound to be different. This thesis aims to address this problem by applying the production line balancing to the bottom gluing process of paint shops to improve the efficiency and ensure the smooth linkage, upon scientific workload research and time testing.

articleTitle: Arriving time control algorithm for dynamic flexible flow shop problem
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper considers the dynamic flexible flow shop problem with unrelated parallel machines at each stage and the objective of the problem is to minimize the total earliness and tardiness penalties of all jobs, or to achieve weighted just in time. In previous studies, the job will never change if it has been assigned to a certain machine. Since the schedule should be updated according to the change of current stages, this paper proposes a mechanism that allows the selected machines to be updated for better schedule. Two kinds of arriving time control algorithms are developed. In addition, three improved ways are used to enhance the efficiency of the two algorithms. At last, these eight different approaches have been compared with two classic methods - the stage to stage feedback approach and the earliest to delivery dispatching rule and computational experiences reveal that the proposed approaches are efficient for the targeted problem.

articleTitle: A hybrid greedy algorithm for the car sequencing problem
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A hybrid greedy algorithm integrated with ant colony optimization is proposed to solve the car sequencing problem. The objective is to determine a vehicle sequence that minimizes the violations of sequencing rules on a mixed-model assembly line. Pheromone and heuristic information are used together to choose the car to be added to the end of the partial sequence. Numerical experiments are performed to demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Assessing supply chain performance based on problem discovery and analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Although great achievements have been made in the study of supply-chain performance measurement (SCPM), there are still lots of disputes and pronounced criticisms about current researches. In order to shed light on these problems, especially for these problems which fail to consider strategies or fail to give sufficient consideration of implementation costs of SCPM, we summarize researches on conceptual models of SCPM in this paper. With these conceptual models as useful tools to locate problems and seek right solutions, we propose assessing supply chain performance from the perspective of strategies, tactics and operations in order to align SCPM with strategies and using the idea of problem discovery and analysis in order to save the implementation costs of SCPM.

articleTitle: Study on incentive contract mechanism of construction project under bilateral moral hazard
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article points out that both the project owners and the contractors probably have moral hazard during the period of project construction, establishes a bilateral moral hazard model of “hidden behavior” applying the principal-agent theory. The model analysis shows that when the information is asymmetric, it is efficient to applying the linear contract mechanism of cost plus incentive fee, but the risk-neutral owners and the contractors only implement the second-best effort level. It also receives the conclusion that when the relative impact rate of the contractors on the project cost increases, the cost sharing coefficient of the linear contract increases too.

articleTitle: The empirical analysis of the effect of Chinese industrial products export trade on the environment
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Since the opening up reform, the foreign trade of China has developed rapidly. The development of foreign trade has made China's economy more dependent on foreign markets. Now with the rapid expansion of foreign trade and industrialization and the quick pace of industrial products, China's environmental problems become very prominent. The international community, governments and people all over the world are increasingly concerned about the issues of trade and environment and this problem has become one of the focal points in the international economic field. This article uses the method of theoretical and empirical analysis and analyzes the situation of Chinese industrial products export and the environmental problems. Furthermore, this article puts forward some measures to improve the effect of Chinese industrial products export trade on the environment.

articleTitle: Quality gaps in new product development
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, the quality gaps in the process of developing a new product in manufacturing enterprises are researched, and some mathematical models are constructed. In the process of new product development, the total quality gap is formed by the accumulation of the quality gaps produced from the stages of the development process. The quality gaps non-linearly increase with the development, and the quality gaps produced in the initial stages make greater contributions to the total quality gap.

articleTitle: A framework for logistics service innovation based on service science
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Service science has received increasing attention from scholars and practitioners in recent years. This paper introduces a framework of service science as innovative approach in logistics service. The framework is designed to analyze the logistics service process at three layers: strategic layer, systematic layer and support layer. Logistics integration platform is adopted and developed as an innovative service delivery system in this framework aligned with the analysis of the process innovation.

articleTitle: Evaluation problem study of undermine production of colliery safety based on fuzzy hierarchy method
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to industry experience, expertise and indepth research, a type of evaluation index system for undermine production of colliery safety is established. Fuzzy Hierarchy evaluation method is applied to determine the weights and scores of evaluation indexes and the grade of undermine production of colliery safety based on a large amount of statistical data of a stateowned colliery, and then suggestions for improvement are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on exploration of centralized management mode of government-invested projects in Shenzhen Municipality
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the further reform in our country's government-invested construction projects, especially in the practice domain, local governments and related functional departments conduct more and more explorations and innovations. This paper will take the practice of the centralized management mode of the government-invested projects in Shenzhen Municipality as research objects. The research will focus on the establishment of the investment control environment and the function arrangement, management mode, and to make a summary of practice, in order to provide guidance for further research.

articleTitle: The design of college student apartment based on ergonomics
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This study is based on domestic and overseas theoretic research and applications in the fields of university apartment. Take the student apartment in college of engineering of Nanjing Agricultural University as an example to analyze the student apartment's present situation. This paper has adopted methods of both questionnaires and interviews to specialize the changes of university students' psychological and behavioral models in different stages and different genders, considered students' common requirements in users' angle. The author utilizes both ergonomics theory and architectural methodology to design the student apartment which can meet the studying and living requirements of different stages of students. The concrete plans and the suggestions are also proposed to create more reasonable and comfortable student apartment environment in the future.

articleTitle: Growth and capital structure—Evidence from panel data of listed firms on SMEs board
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Using the panel data of listed firms on SMEs board in the period of 2005-2009, this paper investigates the relation between growth and capital structure of SMEs in China. With the capital structure measured simultaneously by the total debt-to-asset ratio(TD/A) and long term debt-to-asset ratio(LD/A), and growth measured by the market-to-book asset ratio(M/BA), our results show that there are both negative relations between capital structure and growth of SMEs using TD/A and LD/A to measure capital structure respectively.

articleTitle: Research on informatization model and path of enterprise cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Promoting informatization, based on the common regional characteristics and industrial relationship, is an important strategic measure to support the development of enterprise cluster. From the perspective of value chain, on the basis of the analysis of mechanism that informatization improves continuous value addition of cluster value system, the paper proposes the informatization model of enterprise cluster, emphatically analyzes four informatization dimensions including cluster products, enterprise, network and platform, and designs the realization path of enterprise cluster informatization based on periodic evolution process of enterprise cluster, so as to provide theory method reference for the cluster enterprises and related management department to implement informatization development strategy.

articleTitle: A decision-making method for customized performance-enhancement plan based on Grey Relating-Fuzzy Appraisal Module—An empirical study on technical center of Tianjin Pipe Group Corporation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Companies highly value the processes and the results of performance appraisal. Based on the appraisal scores or ranks, how to make a wise and customized decision to guide staff effectively enhancing their performances is critical to the organizational development as well as to individual capacity. This paper first elaborates the principles and algorithm of “Grey relating-Fuzzy Appraisal Module”, a combination of multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model and grey-relating degree analysis method. Furthermore, this paper discusses the advantage of using Grey relating-Fuzzy Appraisal Module to identify the specific performance-enhancement direction in staff management. Last, the suggested method is testified by the case study of Tianjin Pipe Group Corporation and the conclusion achieved is of high referential value to other Chinese corporate management.

articleTitle: The influential effect of the strength of interfirm network on new product development
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Interfirm network for the impact of new product development has become the problem which managers and scholars are very concerned, but the research about the perspective of new product development conduct from the view of strength of the interfirm network are not specially many. Strength of the interfirm network as important part of enterprise competitiveness, Is there any internal contact with the development of new products? How to display interfirm network intensity better to serve for the enterprise new product development? This paper aims to do the research on the relationship between interfirm network strength and the development of new products. The results support that the closer relationship in network can improve the new product creation and the speed of the new product development. Meanwhile, because of the overlapped skills and the knowledge, the higher knowledge redundancy improves the new product creation and the speed of the new product development.

articleTitle: Urbanization and economic growth: A dynamic panel data study
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the panel data of China's 31 provinces in 1997-2004, the paper uses dynamic panel GMM estimation to test the impacts of urbanization on economic growth taking the urbanization ratio and the urban primacy ratio as urbanization index. The result shows that the urbanization ratio has a negative but small impact on economic growth. Furthermore, it also reflects urbanization boosts economic growth within a certain economic development degree and the growth effect of urbanization turns negative beyond it. Now all provinces are above the critical level, which means a simple extension-type expansion will impede economic growth with the evolution of urbanization. In addition, the urban primacy ratio does not have a significant influence on economic growth, which is inconsistent with the prior finding of Henderson. Therefore, this paper provides suggestions of urbanization in order to promote china's economic growth.

articleTitle: Upgrading core competence of high-tech enterprises—Constructing techno-knowledge management system mode
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on two-dimension analysis and feedback analysis, mode of techno-knowledge management system of high-tech enterprises is constructed in this article. Authors conclude and analyze activities of techno-knowledge management, analyze function of techno-knowledge management in improving core competence from dynamic and systemic angle, and put forward the principles which techno-knowledge management system should follow. An effective way to upgrade core competence of high-tech enterprises is offered.

articleTitle: Development of the quality management Of educational establishments in the Republic of Belarus
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Relevance of the education quality management issue is related to general benchmarks of the process of Education system enhancement. Education quality improvement is one of the most important priorities of the education policy in Belarus. Organization of a reliable quality assurance system is one of the key goals in modernization of the system of professional education and instruction in the Republic of Belarus.

articleTitle: Why do organizations keep funding projects in the face of repeated failure?
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Although most studies agree that most projects fail, proposals for new projects continue to attract funds. In order to resolve the apparent “investment-in-failure” paradox, this paper questions the methodology used in the literature to judge project failure and describes a model that both expands and extends traditional approaches. Implications of the proposed model for the management environment in organizations are also discussed. The model, which is anchored in existing theories of regret and contingency, was tested using a field study, and controlled experiment. We conclude that, despite the apparently small proportions of initiatives completed on time, within budget and to specifications, organizations keep funding projects because an acceptable number of them still represent satisfactory investments to the funding organization.

articleTitle: Tech-Knowledge conformity in innovation of high-tech enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this article author points out requirement of Tech-Knowledge conformity, and regarding software enterprises as example defines Tech-Knowledge conformity, analyzes innovation flow and characteristics, and expounds elaborately Tech-Knowledge conformity modes and ways based on tech-innovation, and HR management ways promoting Tech-Knowledge conformity.

articleTitle: The return policy with time-limit based on consumer inertia
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on consumer behavior, this paper studies retailer's return policy. It introduces both customer inertia and returned time-limit into the return policy for the first time. First, this paper analyzes the inert customer's purchase/return behavior; second, it builds an extended returned model based on the classic newsvendor model; at last, it gives a numeral example using the software matlab, which clearly illustrates the application of our model in the real condition. By analyzing the mathematical model, we can know the seller's optimal sales price and returned price.

articleTitle: Promoting entertainment artists using data mining and lifecycle forecasting techniques
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the thriving development of mass media, entertainment industry has enormous growth. The goal of entertainment agency is to establish an efficient career management system for individual artists. The research aims at developing an approach to evaluate the potential of entertainment artists and to construct their suitable career pathes. In this research, data mining techniques are applied to correlate degrees and types of media exposures and successes of artists. The technology forecasting methods are applied to foresee the future career paths for new artists. Thus, entertainment agencies can assess values of artists, plan appropriate marketing strategy, and cultivate talented artists by utilizing quantitative and systematic methodology.

articleTitle: The 3-demensional dynamic combined evaluation method and its application in supplier selection
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A Dynamic Constitution Evaluation Model for supplier selection and evaluation was suggested in this paper. Subjective weights are given based on G1 method, and objective weights are obtained from entropy method. The combination of subjective and objective weights avoids the one-sided result, which is the limitation of single method. Using dynamic multi-stages linear constitution method on the evaluation scores of the indices, which fully considering the influence of evaluation objects' objective condition on evaluation result, and made up the fortuitous result which only considered the current condition. Finally the practicability of the model is illustrated.

articleTitle: Points worth re-consideration concerning Product Life Cycle Management
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: While the authors give somewhat a detailed discussion of product life cycle management (PLCM) and the characteristics of the various phases of the cycle, as against Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), they disclose their disagreement with the conventional concept on the relationship between the two disciplines, pointing out that rather than irrelevant to and independent of each other, the two disciplines are closely related, having a number of respects in common. In addition they hold that the product life cycle is composed of five phases_ development, introduction, growth, maturity and decline, rather than four_ introduction, growth, maturity and decline as most of literature maintains.

articleTitle: Optimization of insulation thickness for external wall of residential buildings in cold regions of China based on Life Cycle Cost Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Space heating accounts for the greatest energy consumption in cold regions of China. Proper application of thermal insulation is one of the most effective energy conservation measures for residential buildings. Therefore, determining and selecting the optimum thickness of insulation is important not only for the environment but also for the energy costs. In this paper, a mathematical model demonstrating optimal insulation thickness for external walls is established based on Life Cycle Cost Analysis (LCCA). This study is calculated by analyzing the implementation of optimum insulation thickness for external walls of a typical energy efficiency residential building in Tangshan, a city in cold regions of China.

articleTitle: Research on impact of knowledge management capability to technology innovation performance
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper, with combined method of theory and empirical analysis, proposed metrics of knowledge management capability and technology innovation performance, built relation model of knowledge management capability and innovation performance, and made basic assumptions. Then the paper conducted a survey of 98 sample companies, carried out factor analysis and correlation analysis against effective data to verify the original assumptions. Finally, the paper gave corresponding explanation about the conclusion and put forward to some appropriate recommendations.

articleTitle: Forecast of spare parts inventory risk level based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article presents a new classification approach to inventory risk level of spare parts which based on the support vector machine classification principle.
