First, a fuzzy evaluation of spare parts is made in terms of their availability of suppliers, importance, predictability of failure, specificity and lead time. Then a one versus one classification machine model is established. Choosing a sample of historical data of spare parts and undertaking an OVO training stimulation. The model is used to predict the inventory risk levels of test data. The result in this experiment indicates that it is feasible to apply the support vector machine to forecast the spare parts inventory risk level.

articleTitle: IE is the accelerator of economic growth mode transformation of autonomous vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: IE still has a powerful vitality after the financial crises times. The architecture model of IE and economic growth mode transformation is built on the basis of studying the connotation of IE and economic growth mode, and the inner operating mechanism is discussed. Take FAW Car for example, the application and innovation of IE in the economic growth mode transformation of autonomous vehicle enterprises are discussed by using lots of practical cases, then the experience and regular of IE application are put forward.

articleTitle: Adoption and assimilation of TQM strategy from parent company to overseas plant in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The purpose of this study is to demonstrate how the operation strategy, Total Quality Management (TQM), has been adopted and assimilated from parent company to oversea plant efficiently and effectively through the use of The Resource-Based View (RBV) theory framework. Insight experiences from a single case study of tire cord fabric manufacturing plant locating in Thailand are revealed. This company is an offshore plant of parent company in Turkey. The global strategic foundation of this company consists of resources (an employee development aligned with global strategy), values (i.e. integrity, customer focus, open minded, global collaboration, and results driven), and systems (enabling continual improvement and business excellence). In order to establish the leading edge in the market, the parent company has been transferring the platform of quality and operational excellence, which include TQM strategy, to all manufacturing plants over the world.

articleTitle: Study of claim identification model in international project based on process control ideology
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper tends to explore the issues relevant to contractor's claims opportunity identification. According to the condition of construction in FIDIC 1999, a process control-based model is presented in which the claims risk analysis, contract state analysis, event analysis, schedule analysis and cost analysis were combined in conjunction with the system of identifying claim opportunities at contract signing stage, construction stage and completion stage. The model is useful to improve the efficiency of contractor's claim disposal, and keep contractor from missing the best timing of claim.

articleTitle: The cost-benefit analysis model of reverse supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Reverse supply chain is an effective strategy to achieve social sustainable development and enhance the market competitiveness of enterprises. This paper explains the concept and the operational pattern of reverse supply chain. By analyzing the cost and benefit of every process in the reverse supply chain in detail, this paper builds a cost-benefit model based on its operational process. This cost-benefits model supplies an economic basis for enterprises' decision making and development of different stages in business.

articleTitle: Weight Changeable Combination forecast method based On ACA
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The weighted coefficient in combination forecasting model is constant in most of current studies. In fact, if the weighted coefficient is assumed to be constant, the effectiveness and accuracy of combination forecasting model may be unsatisfied. In addition, samples near the time now should be greater contribution to prediction. Taking into the account of the above reasons, a new combination forecast method with changeable weight considering the importance of sample is proposed. ACA is used to search for the best sample weight, and then PLS is used to confirm the weight function of combination forecast model. An empirical study is given to test the effectiveness of this new method.

articleTitle: Supply chain management in retail using Radio frequency identification(RFID)
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper methods for efficient Supply Chain management (SCM) have been discussed to improve core competencies while guaranteeing efficient handling of material and products. The basic structure of SCM has been elaborated taking into account its six main parameters which are Geographical Location of SCM Partners, Logistic Dimensions, Inventory and Forecasting, Marketing and Distribution Channel Management, Product Design, Innovation and New Product Introduction and After Sale Service and Support. This paper mainly brings out the application of Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) in the form of Electronic Product Code (EPC) and as passive tracking device to suit harsh manufacturing environment. In the end Fraud Management schemes have been suggested to minimize the possibility of fraudulent activities in the retail sector.

articleTitle: Research on financial module of investment benefit evaluation system based on thermoelectricity enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Electricity is the basic industry of the national economy. The effective financial evaluation on thermoelectricity enterprises is an important mean and basic work to improve operation and circumvent risks. the financial evaluation of thermoelectricity project investment refers to an assessment process, which is the investment institution conducts a comprehensive analysis and evaluation on financial and social benefits and other relevant content of a project, to make decisions on whether to grant investment or loans support, by using scientific methods and means, according to the relevant policies, laws and regulations, methods and parameters. The paper provides a new progress for the existing financial evaluation system of thermoelectricity enterprise investment, not only to enable investors to grasp the actual operation situation more detailedly, but also to simulate future more clearly, so as to provide a reliable basis for decision-making of the projects.

articleTitle: Uncertainty analysis for pump test based on maximum entropy and Monte Carlo method
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Entropy analysis is a key factor for ensuring the accuracy of measured data in pump test. But a unified and widely accepted evaluation method has not been formed. In this paper, an improved method based on the combination of maximum entropy and Monte Carlo method is proposed. Based on maximum entropy concept, statistical model of random distribution variables was presented, and a parameter estimation method of the distribution function was proposed also. In order to improve the convergence of the numerical estimation method, swarm algorithm is applied to generate initial value. Then, a set of random numbers are generated which are used to estimate the uncertainty of components in pump test. Case study verified the effectiveness and higher accuracy of proposed method.

articleTitle: Improvements in solving resource constrained shortest path problems in column generation context
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Column generation method is an effective way of solving large scale optimization problems. One of the novel improvement methods for column generation applications is the processing of a preprocessing algorithm at the very beginning of the problem to transform the resource constrained shortest path problem of the sub-problem into an unrestricted shortest path problem. This process was previously suggested in the literature as three-stage approach (TSA), in which network reduction, network expansion and iterative solution stages are involved. In this paper, we propose three-stage approach in vectorial form (TSA-V), a variant of TSA, in which the network reduction stage is processed by vectorial comparison of the resources. The effectiveness of both algorithms is compared by solving a real-world airline crew scheduling problem of a medium-haul airline company. Computational results of the airline crew scheduling problem show that TSA-V is more effective in eliminating infeasibilities and solving the iterative solution stage.

articleTitle: An analytical CRM based on customer knowledge
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Targeting at customers, CRM system is definitely of strategic importance for enterprises. However, its huge potential, the analytical function, is not fully exploited. After introducing the customer knowledge and analyzing the current situation of analytical CRM, this paper proposed a model for analytic CRM, and illustrated its application in customer grouping and corresponding strategy.

articleTitle: Research on the slotting optimization of automated stereoscopic warehouse based on discrete particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper analyzed the location assignment strategy of automated stereoscopic warehouse, put forward the idea of the slotting optimization and studied the optimization method, established the slotting optimization model as the optimization strategy for the lowest energy principle and the shortest time principle, proposed the discrete particle swarm algorithm to solve the model. It is proved by simulation that access to goods in accordance with the slotting optimization model, not only reducing energy consumption and warehouse operation costs, but also improving the efficiency of goods storage.

articleTitle: Business logic structure of SaaS-based E-commerce system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The functional requirements of multiple tenants are supported by a single instance in a SaaS System, but the differences between tenants make it difficult to unify in same business logic. Based on the construction of SOA and using BPEL to deploy different processes on application servers, a business process customization model for the application layer is proposed and the specific solution of process customization and implementation are discussed with the combination of Web Service.

articleTitle: Application of Analytic Hierarchy Process in energy sustainable development analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Energy sustainable development analysis is a complex systematic engineering. The plan is influenced by multitudinous factors. Utilizing AHP, industrial factor weight which is bumped into frequently in the determination of energy sustainable development analysis is carried on. Some strategic analysis tools such as IFE matrix, EFE matrix, SWOT matrix are utilized in the dissertation.

articleTitle: Intelligent transport management system for urban traffic hubs based on an integration of multiple technologies
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As the continuous development of technology, the establishment of intelligent transport system has became the trend for development of transport management in the future. In order to constitute a modern three-dimensional urban transport system, there is an urgent need of intelligent management in important traffic hubs inside of a city or for external transport. This paper, by means of integrating advantages of multiple technologies, aims at designing and constituting an intelligent transport management system for traffic hubs, and discussing issues such as design, framework and functional modules in order to increase the level of utilization, safety and comfort, as well as the governmental' capability of decision making.

articleTitle: Measuring efficiency of hand surgery departments using data envelopment analysis(DEA)
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper developed an approach based on data envelopment analysis(DEA) including CCR, BCC and FG models to evaluate the performance of hand surgery departments. Concerning the characteristics of hand surgery, the design of decision making unit(DMU) with 3 input indexes and 3 output indexes were conducted through the communication tool of IDEF0. Five sets of muti-index criteria were introduced to provide a comprehensive measurement. The approach was applied to a case study of 22 hand surgery departments in Mainland China. In the cases, the relative input-output efficiency of service quality, labor, medicine, and facility were measured, and several constructive suggestions about resources allocation and scale were proposed. The case study shows that this efficiency measurement method is applicable and instructive for hand surgery management.

articleTitle: HSE integration procedure management during the construction of the pipe engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: During the construction of the pipe engineering, HSE (Health, Safety and Environment) management and quality control influences safe operation in the period of the operation directly, PetroChina adopts Project Management Team, PMT, Project Management Contractor, Engineering Procurement PMC and Construction, EPC(PMT+PMC+EPC) combined management mode to make sure the effect control during the construction of the pipe engineering. Aimed at the artificial procedure's breaking by the discrepancy of the participants' benefit in this mode for the hard controlling of the HSE and quality, the article brings out procedure integrating management framework based on the whole life period of the pipe engineering, and builds the procedure's hierarchical model and integrating management whole procedure of the pipe engineering. At last, the article gives the case verifying the method is available.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation based on fuzzy fault tree
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In conventional fault tree analysis (FTA), some complex and uncertain events such as human errors cannot be handled effectively. Fuzzy fault tree analysis (fuzzy FTA) integrating fuzzy set evaluation and probabilistic estimation is proposed to evaluate vague events. The reliability of water supply subsystem in fire protection systems is analyzed using the proposed approach and the results prove the validity of the fuzzy FTA.

articleTitle: An appraisement model of meat products safety monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on a comprehensive consideration on influence of the single factor and the interaction among them, the basic principle of analysis hierarchy process is introduced and hierarchical model of various factors is established. Weight of single factors is calculated according to fuzzy judgment matrix. Empirical researches on this model are carried out. In comparison with other safety assessment methods, it proves that fuzzy comprehensive safety evaluation method has better effectiveness and reliability.

articleTitle: A nonlinear programming model for a multi-facility location problem with a probabilistic line barrier
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, a Mixed-integer non linear programming (MINLP) model for a multi-facility location problem in the presence of a probabilistic line barrier is presented in which the starting point of the line barrier uniformly distributed. It is supposed that the distances metric is rectilinear. The objective function minimizes the summation of the weighted expected rectilinear barrier distances between the n new facilities and the m existing facilities and also between the new facilities. To show the applicability of the model, a numerical example is provided. It is worth noting that the global optimal solution is found.

articleTitle: On primal-dual cost allocation schema in multicast communication: Combinatorial game theory model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: We analyze the cost allocation strategy associated with the problem of sending information from some source to a number of communication network users. A multicast routing chooses a minimum cost network that spans the source and all the receivers. The cost of such a network is distributed among its receivers who may be individuals or organizations with possibly conflicting interests. These receivers are likely to cooperate if they are charged the `fair share' of the cost. Providing network developers, users and owners with computable `fair' cost allocation solution procedures is of great importance for network management. We overview some previously published, as well as some new results, in the development of algorithmic cooperative game theory based mechanisms to efficiently compute `attractive' cost allocation solutions for multicast networks. We also present some open cost allocation problems and the potential contribution that combinatorial game theory models might make in the future.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of a novel structure in an automatic sorting system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Reliability and safety is very important for logistic equipments especially sorting system. In this paper a novel structure of automatic sorting system is designed based on Double 2 vote 2 Redundancy (D2V2R) structure. By using this structure, the reliability of the system is enhanced comparing with traditional simplex system and duplex system. Analytical results based on basic reliability analyzing theory are also given for systems using these structures.

articleTitle: Modelling of failure prediction Bayesian network based on fault tree analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the useful failure relationships embedded in the fault tree analysis (FTA), the paper proposes a failure prediction Bayesian Network (FPBN) modelling method to establish the practical model and facilitate its applications. In the modelling method, the transformation of events and logic relationships in FTA to variables, edges and conditional probability distributions (CPD) in FPBN are illustrated. Moreover, considering the developments of advanced detection devices, the detection information is also introduced in the FPBN model. At last, the case study of a tank clutch pedal (TCP) is carried out by transforming its FTA to a corresponding FPBN. The results show that, the proposed method can perform effectively in modelling FPBN based on FTA.

articleTitle: Application of discrete element method in stability analysis for rock slope based on strength reduction
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Discrete element method is a numerical methods using for non-continuous media, which is suitable for high rock slope stability analysis with developed rock fault, joints and cracks. Strength reduction is a numerical methods, widely using in the slope stability analysis, it maintained that the strength reserve coefficient and the stable safety factor proposed by the limit equilibrium is equivalent. Combining the discrete element method with the strength reduction criteria, using two sets of grids: Dense grid represents the condition of joints; Dilute grid is approximate equivalent to the conditions that the rock's integrity is improved after reinforcement. It calculated the high slope of Goupitan plunge pool, analyzed the stability of the natural slope and excavated slope and evaluated supporting effect, this provided a reference for the design and construction of the project.

articleTitle: A new SOM batching heuristic for order picking systems
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Base on the global economics crunch, the enterprise start to reduce the cost in many segments of supply chain in order to reduce the management cost. Therefore, this paper develops a new order batching heuristic (SOMB) for the order picking systems in distribution centers. It applies the idea of Self Organization Map to cluster the orders with higher relativity into a batch to reduce the total order picking distances. The number of SKUs in an order and the number of the same aisles covered for an order batch are the key decision factors. The increasing of SKUs in an order would affect optimum weights of SOMB; also, the weights should be more exactness to enhance the performance of order picking operations. A simulation experiment is executed to verify that the SOMB heuristic can reduce the order picking distances and increasing the utilization of picking vehicle.

articleTitle: The construction technology of collaborative manufacturing service chain based on adaptive multi-agent product structure
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper's proposed the adaptive multi-agent collaborative manufacturing product structure service chain model and discussed its construction technology for the complex collaborative manufacturing task and the lack of appropriate building technology, based on the collaborative production scheduling, in view of the expert decision-making optimization's genetic algorithm and MAS technology as a whole. Through genetic algorithms and MAS technology, it matches the product parts logic manufacturing tasks unit with manufacturing services unit, and sets up the hierarchical manufacturing chain model, even improves the capacity of the manufacturing service chain such as self-organizing, self-adaptation and its' dynamic response level for enhancing synergy processing capacity among collaborative manufacturing enterprises. Finally, a prototype collaborative manufacturing system development and service chain in an enterprise application are presented and proved the technology effectiveness and scientificity.

articleTitle: Lead-time, capacity and pricing decisions for the production seat booking system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This research studies three important decision variables of the lead-time setting, capacity utilization, and pricing decision faced by a firm using the production seat booking system under build-to-order manufacturing environment. The system is modeled as an M/D/1 queue structure and optimization models are developed to determine these variables. The optimal decisions are then derived and their properties are investigated as model parameters change.

articleTitle: Improvement for traditional PERT based on rational risk aversion
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Because of the rational circumvent of the perceived risks and the extended responsibility, project schedule always tend to be conservative, which may cause more waste of safety time in the implementation of projects, and make project management inefficient and cost over-run. This paper introduces a “compensation factor”, which is applied to amend activity durations in traditional PERT in order to make the project schedule more practical. By this method, we can shorten the calculated duration and cumulate all “compensation factor” as a buffer time, which will be put it at the end of the critical path. This new method can help project managers to make a flexible use of the duration of each activity.

articleTitle: The evolutionary game analysis of mine worker's behavior of violating rules
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The evolutionary game model is built by using evolutionary game theory, it depicts working behavior among mine worker in the monitoring situation. The mine worker behavior state can be analysized through the model by giving different paramer, the results discover mine behaviors stability by using characteristics between game parts. The behavior strategy choice change directions is discussed by using different parameters. Some available suggestions are given for mine enterprise managing mine worker behavior of violating rules.

articleTitle: Study on eco-efficiency evaluation of manufacturing system based on Circular economy
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the Circular economy carrying out with great efforts in manufacturing industry, how to evaluate the effect of circular economy in manufacturing system has become an imperative problem of the current study. Eco-efficiency is the effective index which can be used to evaluate circular economy. This paper gives the structure of eco-efficiency evaluation index of manufacturing system based on circular economy, and evaluates the eco-efficiency of manufacturing system with fuzzy mathematics method.

articleTitle: Research on application of simulation technology in container ship stowage problem of port logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As the international logistics industry develops fast, container loading has become a core part of maritime transport, with its efficiency and safety focused by logistics industry. The enlargement of ships makes the container loading problem much more complex than ever. Traditional ways to study these problems now have been difficult to offer effective solutions, while simulation technology not only can fully reflect the essence of modern system theory, but also puts emphasis on both integrity of one whole problem and the connection of each sub problem. By simulating the operation of container terminal, we can have a deep look into the designed links in container logistics system, to check the operational effectiveness, analyze the bottlenecks in system, forecast the results, show the image of system, and implement the optimization of system. Overall, simulation technology provides guarantee for the optimization, security and automation level of high-degree container loading and thus improve the competitiveness of the port, placing a profound impact on future development and the scale expansion of port logistics in China. This paper studies on how to design the simulation of container ship stowage problem.

articleTitle: Complete or incomplete information infrastructure, implications for attention-focus in decision-making
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To help overcome the difficulty of information overload, we conducted simulations to show the importance of information infrastructure in decision-making. Using simulations based on a NK-model, we show that it makes a difference in results whether decision-makers has a complete information infrastructure. Comparing results from two simulations with or without a complete information infrastructure, we find that the attention structure with a complete information infrastructure is significantly better. We then discuss the issue of developing a complete information infrastructure with some real-world examples.

articleTitle: Research on panoramic time-space-oriented enterprise modeling integration architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper analyzed the characteristics of enterprise format, discussed the demand of enterprise modeling in the new environment and new era, and proposed a panoramic time-space-oriented enterprise modeling integration architecture in contrast to the existing enterprise reference system models. It covers integration structure, modeling methods, implementation methods and optimization, which is able to help enterprise modeling and integration application.

articleTitle: Multi-single inventory control model and optimization of spare parts based on group replacement policy
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Maintenance policy has significant effects on the demand of spare part and the total cost of maintenance. In this paper, the multi-single inventory control model of spare part is considered based on the group replacement policy. The mathematical model and corresponding calculation algorithm are proposed according to the problem description. An example is introduced and the simulation result shows that the preventive replace interval can affect the warehouses selection and the total cost; holding cost per item affects the total cost greatly; also, enlarging the rated stock of warehouses which is not enough and can decrease the supply cost of the system.

articleTitle: Improvement research on Vehicle Routing Problem with Simultaneous Delivery and Pickup with time windows for Barreled Water
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The timeliness of Barreled Drinking Water distribution, which involves both pickups and deliveries, is required severely. Taking time windows and pickups and deliveries Constraints into consideration at the same time, the traditional VRP model is reformed and replenished to the time windows constraints VRPSDP mathematical model, and the Genetic algorithms is improved, referring to partially matched crossover method. The solving strategy of Barreled Drinking Water distribution VRPSDP is proposed and the experimental results show that it can solve the problem of VRP in Barreled Drinking Water Company.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation model and application of risks of knowledge management in supply chain node enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Starting from three main processes of knowledge management in supply chain node enterprises, knowledge acquirement, knowledge sharing and knowledge utilization, this study analyzes the risk factors faced in knowledge management and reveals uncertainty about supply chain environment of node enterprises. It further builds up a risk evaluation criteria system for knowledge management in supply chain node enterprises and makes use of the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) to evaluate some risks occurred during the process of knowledge management in supply chain node enterprises. This study verifies scientificity and operability of this evaluation method through an empirical analysis. Also, it will provide the theoretical basis for enterprises to identify and evade the risks of knowledge management and effectively control and manage them by taking corresponding guard measures.

articleTitle: Optimal design of linkage control panels of the port machinery cab based on ergonomics
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Linkage control panels are important parts of the port machinery cab, weather it is correctly operated is directly impact the usable of the machine. Based on the theories and principles of ergonomics, took the crane cab of Shanghai Zhenhua port machine company as an research object, optimization suggests about how to layout the linkage control panels in the space and how to position the control elements, which were suit for crane cabs, were put forward after the analysis of the cab driver's working posture. All these suggestions will also provide some advices for the similar products.

Author Keywords: linkage control panels of the port machinery cab

articleTitle: Study on the agile modeling technology for manufacturing system simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Aiming at the complexity of the simulation model for the agile layout of manufacturing system, an agile modeling and simulation technology is proposed based on Hierarchical Object-oriented Timed Colored Petri Net (HOTCPN) and eM-Plant software to convert workshop layout model into simulation model. HOTCPN and eM-Plant are both based on the hierarchical object-oriented method. Due to the structure similarity between HOTCPN model and eM-Plant model, the mapping relations between them are established and an automatic converting platform has been developed. Based on the developed platform, the control logic in the HOTCPN model of manufacturing system can be automatically translated into the control logic of eM-Plant simulation model, so that the rapid transform of layout model to simulation model is achieved. Finally, a manufacturing cell example is used to validate the presented method.

Author Keywords: HOTCPN (Hierarchical Object-oriented Timed Colored Petri Net )

articleTitle: Evaluation of supply chain partnership based on rough set theory
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: After the Era of Economic Crisis, if an enterprise wants to win the advantageous opportunity, it must have reliable supply chain partners. So the research of evaluation on supply chain partners has become hot contents of supply chain management. Based on the history data of some typical enterprises in choosing partners, this paper use rough sets theory to reduce evaluation indexes. Thus we can obtain a more refined index system without influencing decision-making effect. A series of evaluation rules is also be launched as foundation for the enterprise to build intelligentized partner selection decision support system. It can improve the decision-making efficiency and reduce costs. This method has certain practical significance.

articleTitle: The implementation of collaborative design and manufacture platform based on web services
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Nowadays manufacturers face the great challenges of a worldwide market, collaborative environments and the method of management of the whole product life cycle. Accordingly, a web based platform is proposed for collaborative designing and agile manufacturing. Without face to face discussion and specific CAD/CAM system, manufacturers and designers work for a component with the platform. For the purposes, a platform is created by web services technology. The SOAP messages are used to upload design files and exchange all kinds of information. However, it is difficult and time-consuming to choose better design in the part library. The AHP method is used to assess all suitable design files in the platform server. In the end, a simple example explains this process and the results draw a clear conclusion.

articleTitle: The research on the method of determining BT project repurchase price
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: BT model is widely used in municipal infrastructure construction financing in recent years. The repurchase price of BT project is the core issues between project sponsor and BT investors. Repurchase price consists of two parts: project settlement price and investment income. Return on investment is closely related to bank lending rates, social discount rate and the risk level of investor tolerance. By utilizing CAPM model, the author analyzed how to determine the rate of return required by investors, which effects the return on investment of BT project. The calculating formula of return on investment of BT project is proposed according to different repurchase manner.

articleTitle: A fast method in reconstruction 3D computed tomography medical images
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Computed tomography greatly improves the image information available to surgeons and is quickly becoming one of the most important methods to check for defects inside the patients. However, doctors must check these CT slices and again to find the exact position for the patients. This is not only of waste time but also highly inefficient. This paper presents a fast process to reconstruct 3D surfaces from 2D CT scanned data. Based on the geometric models, a series of 2D CT image slices can be read and transformed into profiles. A 3D B-Spline patch model is then generated. After that it can also be converted to VRML format for virtual surgical application. An actual rapid prototyping model is then made for checking the design process. This actual model allows doctors or patients to observe the CT slices in 3D. This system decreases training time and provides references for medical image research.

articleTitle: Modeling and application for cellular formation under dynamic environment
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In recent years, the cellular formation is attended with the increasingly fierce market competition, diversification and personalization of product demand and delivery conditions. Many researchers have put forward cell reconfiguration to meet the different demand in each period, but they don't consider the product can be processed in different routes in the same period to decrease the reconfiguration cost and other relation cost. So a 0-1 nonlinear multi-objective mathematical model is brought forward considering the purchase cost, operational cost and reconfiguration cost to adapt the different demand in each period. At last, a numerical example is given and it proves that the model is effective.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis on IPO underpricing of GEM and SME and policy implication
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Growth Enterprises Market (GEM) and Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises Board (SME) were new securities markets in China, in this article we compared the IPO underpricing of GEM and SME, explored the characteristics of GEM and SME in pricing and offering by examining the relationships between the IPO underpricing with market index, offering volume and offering price-earnings ratio, to expound the problem of GEM in pricing and offering, and provided policy suggestions to the questions.

articleTitle: Study on game among government and construction units about green engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Green engineering is certain require of building resource conserving and environment friendly society, it is also the guarantee for sustainable development of construction industry. However, for saving investment and reducing project cost, construction units, as investors, are usually reluctant to implement green engineering. So it is necessary for government to take administrative means to supervise construction units. In this paper, three static game models for green engineering between the government and construction units are established based on hypotheses, and equilibrium strategies are deduced respectively. According to the equilibrium strategies, the government couldn't promote construction units to take green engineering only with direct rewards. But if the government gives the public an incentive to supervise construction units, and strengthen the punishment dynamics, the green engineering can be promoted effectively.

articleTitle: The research of procurement strategies for the Chinese herbal medicine enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article is concerned about the problem of material procurement which exists in many Chinese herbal medicine enterprises. Based on the characteristics of some Chinese enterprises, a model of purchasing raw materials with the aim to have the lowest cost is established for an enterprise and it is solved by using LINGO. The computational results show the model can be used for the enterprise to make certain period of the procurement plan.

articleTitle: An integrated dual resource management and production planning system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Dual resource constrained (DRC) systems are those with capacity constraints which stem from both machines and human operators. Such systems are prevalent in real-life industries and resource planning must acknowledge the unique characteristics inherent in different types of resources in order to provide optimal schedules. In particular, the inclusion and consideration of human characteristics is necessary to allow more accurate depictions of realistic situations. This paper proposes an integrated dual resource management and production planning system that is able to evaluate the combined effects of numerous worker related issues such as capability, efficiency and reliability. The resultant information can then be used to produce a set of optimised schedules accordingly. The proposed system will be module based to provide flexibility and allow easy customization to suit different industry needs.

articleTitle: Crew scheduling models in airline disruption management
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper investigates the intra-fleet and inter-fleet model for the solution of crew scheduling problem during airline irregular operations. The intra-fleet model is widely adopted in the airline industry where flight is grouped together and works typically within a fleet. The inter-fleet model on the other hand, splits of flight attendant groups and reassign of them across different fleet. Though both these two models belong to the set covering problem with side constraints, the former is a 0-1 set covering problem while the latter is a general set covering problem, they exhibit different computational characteristics and a simulated annealing algorithm is developed and applied for models that are difficult to solve. Our results also show that the intra-fleet model, though widely used in practice, limits the solution space and could lead to inferior solutions; the inter-fleet model, on the other hand, offers much better solutions that could save millions of dollars for airlines.

articleTitle: Research plan for harnessing wave energy in Egypt
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Marine renewable energy sources are crucial alternatives for a sustainable development. Egypt comprises around 3000 kilometers of sea coasts with different conditions. This article presents a brief research plan for establishing a technological and industrial foundation for making use of wave energy in Egypt. Remarks were conducted in order to present the significant role and benefits of such cost effective researches in the preliminary phases of introducing the wave energy to the Egyptian market.

articleTitle: The improved BCC RTS method in data envelopment analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: When estimating RTS (returns to scale) using the BCC RTS method in DEA (data envelopment analysis), there exist multiple optimal solutions which lead to error RTS estimation. This paper introduces the improved BCC RTS method for this problem. Given the existence of an optimal solution with u*<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> ≠ 0 in the BCC multiplier model, the existence of an optimal solution with u*<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> = 0 is the focus. A system of linear equality is constructed for the focus. And the corresponding 0-objective linear programming is also constructed to verify the feasibility of the system of linear equality. Therefore, RTS can be identified by the corresponding 0-objective linear programming and the obtained optimal solution in the BCC multiplier model.

articleTitle: Partnerships among different participants in construction industry of Taiwan: Critical success and failure factors
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In a traditional contract environment in the construction industry, the client and construction professionals often develop a Win-Lose mentality in operating projects. This condition often creates conflicts in communication and cooperation, or could even lead to litigations between clients and professionals. The progress of production would thus be affected greatly. Partnering is achieved through the cooperation of both client and professional. With little start-up costs, partnering can create a Win-Win situation for both the client and professionals. Partnering can improve efficiency in construction projects, and is one of the most innovative ways in reducing conflicts in construction project. The purpose of the study was to gather the construction industry's opinions on critical success and failure factors of partnering agreements. The data have been analyzed by use of means and ranking techniques. The study shows that ⌈effective communication⌋ is perceived as the most important critical success factor in the construction project partnering. Some of the other perceived important critical success factors are ⌈technical expertise⌋, ⌈consistent with objectives⌋, ⌈questioning attitudes⌋ and ⌈commitment to quality⌋. The study also suggests that in the construction industry, ⌈issues being allowed to slide and escalate⌋, ⌈lack of continuous open and honest communication⌋ , ⌈controlling body's being lack of technical knowledge⌋, ⌈stakeholders who don't commit to the partnering arrangement⌋ and ⌈stakeholders who don't develop a win-win attitude⌋ are viewed as the main factors which often cause failure of alliances and partnering.

articleTitle: An analysis about scattering agricultural risk of farmers based on contract farming
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Contract farming connects an enterprise and farmers into one system, it will scatter agricultural risk which is caused by fluctuating of farm products' market price between leading enterprise and farmers. Consequently farmers that only can support little risk will be faced with less agricultural risk. Joining in contract farming will cause farmers income fluctuate, and the fluctuation can be measured by standard deviation or coefficient of variation. By way of analyzing average income of the farmers who have planted garlic in Henan province, this paper illustrates the agricultural risk of farmers who have adopted contract farming, from the perspective of standard deviation and coefficient of variation. The result show that contract farming, as one of the most important pattern of the industrialization of agriculture, is playing an important part in scattering farmers' agricultural risk, and promoting the adjustment of agricultural structure.

articleTitle: The establishment and analysis of time series model of per capita GDP in Yunnan, China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The inertia and the time lag exist in the most of economic time series. Through the analysis of such inertia, the internal laws in the time series could be studied and the economic development could be predicted. Based on the actual conditions of per capita GDP from 1978 to 2007 in Yunnan Province, China, ARMA model is used to establish the time series model of per capita GDP in Yunnan Province and to analyze its law. Compared to the real value and the predicted value of per capita GDP from 2003 to 2007 of Yunnan Province, it concludes that the relative error is small (the rate of average error is -1.04%) and the model could predict the per capita GDP very well. Therefore, this paper provides an excellent tool which is used to predict the economic development.

articleTitle: Supplier evaluation and selection under the context of reducing carbon emissions across a supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper addresses issues about supplier evaluation and selection under the context of reducing carbon emissions across a supply chain. Firstly, describes carbon emissions that suppliers generate across a supply chain. Secondly, determines criteria to evaluate suppliers. Thirdly, adopts TOPSIS approach based on entropy weight to evaluate and select the suppliers. Finally, gives an example for application.

articleTitle: The optimization of a multiplier algorithm with NCP function
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper introduces a new multiplier algorithm that can be used to solve the problems of nonlinear programming with inequality constraints. It first transforms the original problem of an inequality constraint into an equivalent problem of an equality constraint with the Fischer-Burmeister nonlinear complementarity (NCP) function. Subsequently, by using the modified DI PILLO method, the equality constraint problem is transformed into the problem of unconstrained minimization. The solution of the original constraint problem can be obtained by solving a minimum of an unconstrained continuously differentiable function on the basis of an appropriate assumption. The modified inaccurate generalized Newton method is adopted in this paper to solve the problem of the transformed unconstrained minimization.

articleTitle: Optimization by linear network coding
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Network coding is a new paradigm in data transport and promises to change many aspects of networking. This paper briefly reviews the basic concept, fundamental theorem, and applications to optimization of linear network coding. The optimized objectives include throughput of a network, delay, energy consumption, storage space, etc.

articleTitle: An analysis of Knowledge sharing within organization based on the psychological contract
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Knowledge management is a principal instrument to improve enterprise core competence. Knowledge sharing can advance knowledge from individual level to organizational level, so that is one of the critical sectors in knowledge management. An overview of the national and international researches on knowledge management is presented in this paper. Then the psychological contract is defined as the key factor affecting knowledge sharing. Based on that, the knowledge sharing model and the serving system for knowledge sharing are established, combining the knowledge management theory and practice, which can greatly increase the feasibility of knowledge management.

articleTitle: Research on mechanism and identification of core competitiveness in large construction enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The diversification of the construction market players, as well as the diversification of construction products and services, makes the construction market competition increasingly complex and intense. How to continue consolidating the domestic market and constantly developing the international market, how to improve their core competitiveness and maintain its sustainable competitive advantages, has become a development strategy of the construction companies, especially large construction enterprises (LCE). This paper defines the connotation of core competitiveness of LCE, analyzes elements of the core competitiveness, explores formation mechanism of the core competitiveness, and proposes an effective method of identifying its core competitiveness.

articleTitle: A new view field of technological innovation—A thought of faddy innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Manufacturing is main industry in our national economy, in this paper a new thought of technological innovation is put forward after analyzing the causation about the weak innovation in Chinese manufacturing, which is called faddy innovation, its thought is as follow: combining security, saving energy and resource, or protecting environment and so on with certain product, then do some research on this product to innovate new technology, which will bring rich and generous profit but avoiding going to research original core-technology. At the same time a pathway is given to complete the process of faddy innovation in order to get mainstream technology or core-technology, which is based on dissertated fully the predomination of faddy innovation. Faddy innovation is different from brim innovation, model of technological pullulation and change of profit share about faddy innovation is fully expatiated too, it possesses the stronger pertinence and maneuverability.

articleTitle: Study of SME credit evaluation system under the current financial crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Under financial crisis's situation, our country SME financed difficultly because of lacking the consummation credit evaluation system. This article used the system engineering methods and unified our country SME's current condition to study credit evaluation system. It established the SME's credit evaluation indicator system and determined the weight, and then built the evaluation model by use of fuzzy quality synthetic evaluation method. The results can provide the policy-making basis for the government and the credit departments evaluating our country SME's credit.

articleTitle: Virtual integration as an approach to engender product innovation and accelerate product development time: A literature analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Global competitiveness has forced manufacturing firm, as an internal constituents, to work closer with their suppliers and customers in order to produce highly innovative product in shorter time interval. However as the business trends in manufacturing industry have evolved, centralized integration has become obsolete and no longer be efficient. Concurrent engineering methodology allows manufacturing firms to adopt a new collaboration approach called virtual integration. With the aid of computer-mediated communication, virtual integration is believed to be a promising solution to NPD collaboration issues. Therefore, this conceptual paper is aimed to seek for a new approach to engender product innovation which at the same time accelerates product development time in geographical dispersed setting through literature analysis. Some prepositions are developed to provide a preliminary understanding on this issue that would be beneficial for future research in this field.

articleTitle: Clustering algorithm of collaborative manufacturing cells based on entropy
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A method of reconfigurable manufacturing cells regarding process route as the basic clustering particle is proposed according to the similarity of production process after analyzing the relationship of parts, process routes and manufacturing resources. Parts and manufacturing resources were reconfigured automatically into logic manufacturing cells by mapping to process routes clusters, which are clustered firstly. A reconfigurable manufacturing cell of clustering algorithm based on entropy is presented considering process routes clustering in view of entropy. Though this method a process route is regarded as a spatial data point and its character is described by manufacturing resources. Finally, an example was given to validate the effectiveness of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Watershed pollution control plans effect assessment: Countermeasure adjustment modeling and simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As the effect of watershed pollution control planning is hard to evaluated, this paper brought forward a kind of methodology to assess the countermeasures' effects on the water body. A kind of Artificial Neural Net (ANN) work called Radial Basis Function (RBF) was used to simulate the uncover interrelationships among the measures and the water quality indicators. After building their internal net, some certain input parameters which represents the environmental protection investments or alike in the net, were adjusted mandatorily. The variations of the output water quality indicators showed the effect of these countermeasures. The simulation result showed that investment on environmental protection is a positive index for water quality improvement.

articleTitle: Service perception-oriented evaluation of the manufacturing resource' service capability
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Manufacturing resource is the important node in the service chain of enterprise to provide services for all customers. Based on the analysis of service perception information on quality, we establish the evaluation model of manufacturing resource's service capability. By means of the objective evaluation of the manufacturing resource's service capacity, we provide scientific basis for enterprise to improve the service capacity of manufacturing resources and allocate manufacturing resources reasonably.

articleTitle: A Hierarchy Gap Method (HGM) for risk identification
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The importance of risk identification has been concerned more and more by engineers these years. However, there remain some difficulties in risk identification: it excessively relies on engineers' experience, lacks quantificational assessing method, and rarely makes use of computer even as assistant. Aiming at these weaknesses, a new approach to identify risk, Hierarchy Gaps Method (HGM) is proposed. Firstly Hierarchy Method is established using Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and Property Breakdown Structure (PBS); then new risk definitions and its symbols and algorithms are given. Finally the new approach of risk identification, HGM, is concluded. HGM has the following properties: 1 Risk management personnel's workload is reduced obviously and their efficiency is improved greatly, because most of the logical analysis is processed by computer and less relies on expect. 2 HGM is more logical and systematical while quantificational analyzing method is adopted, and risk can be identified completely and accurately. 3 The HGM is an open process, so productions of other research can be well involved.

articleTitle: The optimal maintenance policy proportion for the repairable warranty equipment using decreasing-failure-rate-reduction method
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this study, we define the time interval [0, w) as warranty period and the time interval [w, w+m*(w/(n+1)) ] as the outside of warranty period. The manufacturers provide the customer with preventive maintenance as well as repair policy for free when the equipment was used in the warranty period; consumers need to pay for the same degree of preventive maintenance when the equipment was used in the outside of warranty period. In this research, the method of preventive maintenance is the decreasing failure rate reduction. After each implementation of preventive maintenance which reduced the failure rate, there is the level of imperfect preventive maintenance of limited proportion. The proportion of maintenance was divided into a decreasing maintenance proportion. We obtained the optimal number of maintenance, the optimal proportion of maintenance degree, the cost of preventive maintenance for decreasing maintenance proportion model. In the final, numerical and sensitivity analysis verify the results.

articleTitle: The study on evaluation system of university interdisciplinary based on principal component analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: One important prerequisite for improving the level of university interdisciplinary is to establish a comprehensive evaluation system for the evaluation of existing interdisciplinary. A comprehensive evaluation system including ten indices was built based on the analysis of interdisciplinary construction in college. On the basis of this evaluation system, it analyzes the interdisciplinary level of a certain university in Zhengzhou, using principal component analysis, and then makes a further analysis of the evaluation result. It proves through examples that it is effective and feasible to apply the principal component analysis to the establishment of the interdisciplinary comprehensive assessment system.

articleTitle: Research on the profits distribution of the supply chain using shapely value method
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, shapely value method is used to solve the problem of benefits distribution of the supply chain as a virtual dynamic alliance, and through a correction algorithm with an example, the risks values and interests shared by the enterprises in the supply chain is analyzed based on the acceptable satisfaction degree analysis, providing a reasonable feasibility strategy allocation of the interests.

articleTitle: Research on the operations strategy of Chinese manufacturing enterprises under the background of international subcontracting
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the integration of the global economy, more and more Chinese manufacturing enterprises are expanding beyond our traditional borders, so research on the operations strategy under the background of international subcontracting is becoming increasingly important. The first part of this paper reviews the development of the operations strategy, gives a survey on lean and agile manufacturing. The second part of this paper uses GVC theory to analyze Chinese manufacturing enterprises' international positioning, puts greater emphasis on the strategy of Chinese manufacturing enterprises' international operations. The final part points out those Chinese manufacturing enterprises should integrate into the global value chain, and the development of high-end OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) is the main choice for Chinese manufacturing industry in the future.

articleTitle: Measuring airport production efficiency based on two-stage correlative DEA
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper puts forward a two-stage correlative DEA model to measure airport production efficiency. The complicated production process of decision-making units is decomposed into two sub-processes. The correlative DEA model is used to evaluate the airport production efficiency by considering the co-relationship of sub-processes within the whole production process; an empirical study on 8 airports in Asia is conducted and it analyzes the factors influencing the airport inefficiency with Tobit regression mode. The results indicate two-stage correlative DEA model can give more information to improve the airport's efficiency than one-stage DEA model.

articleTitle: An empirical study of the knowledge work efficiency under dynamic network environment
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, the relationship between knowledge work efficiency and its influencing factors is studied. Firstly, a model describing the relationship between knowledge work efficiency and its influencing factors is built on the basis of four hypothesizes. Then, an empirical study is carried out. By factor analysis, thirteen principal components are extracted from six kinds of influencing factors, and three principal components are extracted from the evaluation indexes of the knowledge work efficiency. Correlation analysis and regression analysis are employed to establish the relationship between influencing factors and knowledge work efficiency. It is found that among the six kinds of influencing factors, task complexity and work ability directly influence result effect of knowledge work efficiency; work system and information resources directly influence human capital effect of knowledge work efficiency; group relationship, work willingness and information resource directly influence collaboration effect of knowledge work efficiency.

articleTitle: Risk-minimizing hedging for stochastic payment styled contingent claims
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Measuring financial risks with the conditional mean square error process of cost, we construct risk-minimizing hedging model and study the dynamic hedging problem for stochastic payment styled contingent claims. For any given contingent claim with stochastic payment flow, we firstly prove that there is a unique risk-minimizing hedging strategy by taking advantage of the G-K-W decomposition theorem; then, with the Bellman's principle of optimality, explicit expressions of hedging strategies are acquired and these expressions only comprise conditional moments of risky asset's price and stochastic payment; lastly, at the end of this paper, we take insurance payment for an example to illustrate the technique and conclusions mentioned in this paper are reasonable and feasible.

articleTitle: An empirical study of the relationship between the capability of IT and BPR in equipment manufacturer in Guizhou province
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to explore effective ways to improve the performance and ensure the success of BPR, the paper puts forward a conceptual model and 4 hypotheses describing the relationship between the capability of IT (information Technology) and BPR. Factor Analysis, Correlation Analysis, Multiple Linear Regression, Canonical Correlation Analysis and One-Way ANOVA are as well as the SPSS13.0 statistical software is used to test the hypotheses. The relationship between BPR and the capability of IT is concretely revealed; it preliminarily explored how contextual factors (for example, the size of the enterprise) influence role which the capability of IT plays in BPR. The result showed that four factors of the capability of IT play positive roles in the success of BPR, various factors influence BPR differently, and there wasn't a significant difference in the depth of implementing BPR among enterprises in different size.

articleTitle: Uncertainty research on economic reliability of equipment based on Extended Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Life cycle cost is an important index to measure the economics of an equipment system, however, many existing uncertainties pose great challenges to researchers in this field. In this paper, the relationship between cost and reliability under uncertain circumstances was analyzed, and a tradeoff model considering the uncertainties between the reliability and the cost was presented, in which the uncertainty problems were solved by using the Extended Monte Carlo Simulation(EMCS) method. The EMCS method is an extension of the traditional Monte Carlo Simulation where its simulating process is extended to cover the stage of building models such that not only the inputs are iteratively generated but also the model is iteratively rebuilt. This model can better analyze the economic cost interval of complex equipment with given reliability ranges, and finally a case study on a weapon system was given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on maintenance management object structure mode based on ROM
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the requirement of integration manufacturing and modern production manner, requirement analysis is discussed. That is one of the core of ROM-Requirement-Oriented Maintenance which is a new theory and method of maintenance management. Four-source approaches of maintenance requirement are analyzed. Distinguish business maintenance requirement from technology management and policy environment is brought forward. Several methods to distinguish maintenance requirement are pointed out. Four basic levels of business maintenance of functionality, security, economy and environment are discussed. On this basis the influence factors of deciding enterprise maintenance management object are analyzed. Finally, administrative levels stair structure is put forward and three dimension orientation model or maintenance management object is studied.

articleTitle: TOC Portfolio Selection Model for NPD projects of the biotechnological industry
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Portfolio management can provide optimal investment strategies and the best allocation of scarce resources that will allow a company to make the largest profits. In Taiwan, most individual enterprises in the biotechnology industry are small and most of their limited resources are put into R&D. Therefore, picking out an effective choice of companies to include in an investment portfolio is an important issue for long-term business development. This study presents the five-step focusing procedure of the Theory of Constraints, also known as the TOC Portfolio Selection Model. This model allows a company to concentrate on the optimal allocation of constrained resources and to realize the maximum expected profits. A set of selection methods based on the key resource is established. A case study profiling the bio-chip industry is used here as an example to illustrate the TOC Portfolio Selection Model. The results indicate that the proposed method is superior to more traditional ones.

articleTitle: Analysis on the influencing factors of HRO degree
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the rapid development of service outsourcing around the world, significance of human resource management outsourcing is also greatly highlighted. As one of the determinants on efficiency of outsourcing, outsourcing degree of human resource management is often considered key to success of human resource outsourcing. Based on theories of core competence, transaction cost economics and relational contract; the authors in this paper try to find the influencing factors of outsourcing degree mainly from four dimensions, i.e. the outsourcer's features, the supplier's features, the transaction characteristics and the cooperative relationships. Then the authors establish model of outsourcing degree, and propose conclusions and directions for further research.

articleTitle: Disciplinary competition evaluation basis on the DEA cross-efficiency analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The core of international competition of a university lies on the disciplinary competitiveness. In order to create and enhance the disciplinary competence, we should firstly establish a whole reasonable and efficient discipline evaluation system. Comparing with other evaluation methods, DEA has its distinct advantages in the process of evaluating the efficiency of the multiple inputs, multiple outputs Decision Making Unit. This essay introduces the method that how to use the Cross-efficiency concept to sort the decision making units, on the basis of which to give a comprehensive evaluation to a certain discipline, and to make a further analysis on how to sort each decision making unit.

articleTitle: Application of Partial Least-squares Regression to oil atomic emitting spectrum data of a type diesel engine
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Aiming at relation between the concentrations of wearing elements of diesel engine and it's loads(X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>), cylinders' clearances(X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) and runtime after renewing oil(X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>), the Partial Least-squares Regression(PLSR) has been used to analyze the oil atomic emitting spectrum data of a 6-cylinder diesel engine. The results show that Cu concentrations variance explained by the five components is largest. These components are derived from X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>. The PLSR-function concerning Cu can forecast Cu concentrations well. It has proved perfect in forecasting all the Cu concentrations of the 69 samples in the seven kinds of operating conditions. The effect of X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> upon Cu concentrations has been effectively evaluated by the Variable Important in Projection (VIP). As compared with the obvious effect of cylinder's clearances(X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) and that of runtime(X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>), the effect of the loads is small(X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>).

articleTitle: The study on balance of production schedule and capability of Deli Molded products Co. LTD
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Production schedule is an important part of normal operation of enterprises. In order to gain profits, the enterprise needs a scientific system for the major planning of parts production and workshop operation, thus to guarantee the completion of orders.

articleTitle: Optimization of bi-directional press line scheduling based on hybrid genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper addressed the scheduling problem in a press job shop environment. A heuristic-based scheduling model is proposed by analyzing the characteristics of bi-directional press line. The objective is to improve the machine utilization rates and to balance the load of production lines, with the consideration of machine constraints, operation constraints and batch constraints. A novel heuristic rule is proposed to conduct machine allocation, which is incorporated into genetic algorithm to address the press job shop scheduling problem. Experiments results showed that the proposed algorithm can achieve good performance.
