articleTitle: Empirical analyses of relationships between external driving force and organizational performance for the adopted green supply chain management - an example of Taiwan's Hybrid Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In recent years, the green management has become an indicator of industry. Being not the unique goal in management of one enterprise which is devoted to R&D, production and sale, the creation of maximum profits has been replaced by the sustainable green management. With Hybrid Electric Vehicles (HEVs) taken as the object to be studied, this research is intended for (1) Realizing the adopted green supply chain management practice for the green issue in Taiwan's HEV market; (2) Realizing the principal external factors involved in the adopted green supply chain management practice for the green issue in Taiwan's HEVs market; (3) Investigating the relationships between the green supply chain management practice adopted in Taiwan's HEV market and the external driving force or the organizational performance.

articleTitle: Guided grip force of the dominant hand for male subjects
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Subjective rating has been adopted in quantifying the physical exertion in industrial works. In this study, an experiment was conducted to measure the grip force of twenty, male subjects under guided-gripping scenario. The subjects were requested to apply a power grip force with one of the four exertion levels towards their maximum voluntary contraction (MVC) using their dominant hands. The analysis of variance was conducted to test the variations of the grip forces among different level of force exertion. The results were statistically significant (p<0.0001). A linear regression model was established to describe the relationship between the gripping force and the perceived hand exertion based on the Borg's CR-10 scale. This model was statistically significant at p<0.0001 and with an R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of 0.9. The Pearson's correlation coefficient between the grip force and the rating of the CR-10 scale was 0.95. The results of this study showed that the guided grip force of the dominant hand of the male subjects had linear relationship with the ratings of CR-10 scale. Therefore, the CR-10 scale is appropriate as a quantitative measure of perceived hand grip exertion of the dominant hand for males.

articleTitle: A research on the pricing policy for remanufacturing producer
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the growing attention to the environmental issues, the remanufacturing industry has more and more opportunity, and the remanufacturing producers can get more competitiveness as well. This paper uses the option pricing model to help the remanufacturing producers to price the used product according to the final price of the product, so that the producer can get ideal profit.

articleTitle: Institutional holding, idiosyncratic volatility and information flow
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper investigates the effect of institutional holding on idiosyncratic volatility and information flow. We document that firms with larger pretrade institutional ownership have more access to firm-specific information, which leads to larger idiosyncratic volatility. Institutional trading, with Fund as an exception, has no effect on idiosyncratic volatility and private information. Generally, institutional trading accelerates the incorporation of current and future earnings information into stock price.

articleTitle: Analysis of education service providers' demand for entrepreneurial ability: The employment dilemma and opportunity for technical and vocational school student teachers in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The purpose of this study is to examine education service providers' demand for entrepreneurial ability. To achieve this goal, in this study we first used in-depth interviews with student teachers in the education service business to understand their motives for starting their own businesses, their entrepreneurial ability and the elements for starting their own businesses. The results showed that the entrepreneurial ability of teachers in the education service business should be based on “educational philosophy and professional knowledge”. First of all, they should have “business function” ability such as marketing, economics, finance, accounting, management and IT as their main abilities, followed by “business assessment” ability, such as global market knowledge, legal knowledge and business planning ability. The final ability will be “entrepreneurship and entrepreneurial opportunities” as the reflection of entrepreneurs' setting of cognitive awareness and goal-orientation in the education service business after their assessment of the business.

articleTitle: A new ranking method for efficient units in Data Envelopment Analysis with Expanded Feasible Region
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Scholars have proposed many methods of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) for re-ranking already. However, in many re-ranking methods, some cannot guarantee to effectively re-rank the decision making units (DMUs) which have the same efficiency. In this research, we would propose a method that can guarantee to be completely re-ranking. Through further investigating and originally research, the Expanded Feasible Region Method for re-ranking is proposed by this research. This method not only has the function of re-ranking, it can also attest the thought that decreasing number of input items or output items can increase the discrimination of efficiency. To proof the efficiency of the method mentioned in this research, we will not only give examples to explain the method of re-ranking, but also proposes one theorem and two corollaries to prove it, showing the accuracy of the concept adduced in this research.

articleTitle: An empirical research of chinese university students personal values and costume consumption value model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Previous studies showed that values affected consumption behavior. Taking a large group of consumers - Chinese university students (CUS) as the object, an empirical research has been made on personal values, value orientation of costume consumption behavior and their relationships, which has revealed the structure of CUS personal values and the costume consumption value demands. The data indicate that there is a strong correlation between the both. The different values of sub-groups have a different costume consumption value model. Conclusions could provide an exemplification for exploring complicated consumption behavior from the perspective of personal values and an analytical framework under the values dimension for market segmentation and target group positioning.

articleTitle: The design of cooperative planning processes in railway bureaus based on roles, activities and time sequences
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The successful design of complex cooperative planning process on daily dispatching plan allows multi dispatchers in railway bureaus to cooperatively make daily dispatching plans. This is helpful to improve the accuracy of daily dispatching plan and further to improve the overall efficiency of railway transportation in China. And building the cooperative planning process is also important for the configuration of the transporting dispatching management information system (TDMS 4.0) used in railway bureaus in China. However, designing such a process is very difficult, considering the complexity of the process. In this paper, a new design method based on roles, activities and time sequences is provided. Finally, the new cooperative planning process is constructed by re-arranging the time sequences relationships among roles, activities in the current process.

articleTitle: Application of back propagation neural network on performance evaluation of enterprise informatization
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper designs a enterprise informatization index system from the areas of finance, business process, customer service and strategy and development, based on Balanced Score Card (BSC) theory. A model based on back propagation neural network is established for evaluating the level of enterprise informatization performance. Eventually, we apply the new model to real cases to prove its good precision and practical value.

articleTitle: Combination forecasting of the golf courses in China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Modern golf presented in China has more than 20 years. With the rapid economic development and the growing number of golf enthusiasts prodded, the golf courses in China grow gradually, and the golf industrial-scale shapes preliminarily. Scientific forecast of the scale of golf courses has important significance for rational planning the development of golf industry. Based on the size of golf history data, the article predicts the scale of development of golf courses in 2015 and 2020 with combination forecasting method.

articleTitle: Research on return supply chain supernetworks equivalence with computations
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of return supply chain, we establish a multi-level nonlinear supernetworks model which intends to describe the behaviors of the manufacturers, distributors and the consumers. The optimal object is defined as the profit maximization in the model. An algorithm is employed to decompose the network problems into simple sub-problems and enable the researchers to get a clearer view of the material quantity and the transaction prices between iterations. And then, a solution analysis is made on the model by use of variational inequality theory to define the material volume and transaction price. Finally, a computer-based simulation is made on the solution solving process. The simulation result shows that the Equilibrium solution could be achieved with a certain degree of variance.

articleTitle: Research on the intelligent decision-making support system of securities
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It is an urgent task for securities investment managers to enhance their securities investment decision-making by taking advantage of artificial intelligence. This paper aims to build an intelligent securities investment decision-making support system, and uses data-driven decision-making support methodology to conduct an in-depth analysis of the prominent issues in knowledge-based securities investment decision-making support. Some of the research achievements described in this paper have been applied to my company, passed evaluation by an expert panel, and devoted to practical purposes, with significant results achieved.

articleTitle: Medium-term multi-plant capacity planning problems for semiconductor foundry
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The foundry is an industry whose demand varies rapidly and whose manufacturing process is quite complicated. This paper explores issues of mid-term capacity planning in the foundry. First of all, issues of capacity planning of the foundry are categorized. Secondly, focusing on the multi-site planning, an increment strategy for the number of the accessory tool—“photo mask” is proposed to increase the flexibility of production. The related decisions include how to appropriately allocate the forecast demands of products among multiple sites and decide the production quantities of products in each site after receiving the customer confirmed orders. By constructing the mathematical programming model of capacity planning, it is found that the rates of capacity utilization and customer order fulfillment are effectively enhanced by adding new masks to increase the production flexibility.

articleTitle: Dynamic pricing based on the customer's preference of remanufacturing products
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Remanufacturing is one of the important task that relative to the reverse logistics of the product recycling, usually the economic and environmental impact should be considered. Comparing with the new product, the remanufacturing product there are many characteristics, such as product quality uncertainty, market unclear, etc., so the pricing problems of remanufacturing product will be difficult. In this paper, according to differences in product quality and customer preference for remanufacturing product, based on the objective of maximizing customer satisfaction and firm profits, using by two-way auction transactions game theory, the dynamic pricing model based on customer preferences for remanufacturing products is constructed, and the corresponding conclusions can help the remanufacturing enterprises to determine the price.

articleTitle: Coordinating a channel with a joint VMI and consignment contract for a deteriorating item and stock dependent demand
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The aim of the paper is to coordinate a vertically distribution channel (one vendor multiple retailers) under joint vendor-managed inventory (VMI) and consignment contractual arrangement. The product is deteriorating in time at a constant rate and with stock-level dependent demand. We formulate the channel as a profit-maximization model and carry out equilibrium analysis to represent the performance the coordination mechanisms. In addition, the efficient frontier is constructed geographically to illustrate the feasible region of Pareto improvements from the channel-wide aspect. Our analysis reveals that the joint VMI and consignment policy will obtain a lower retail price, more replenishment quantity and a shorter reorder cycle than these under a VMI only policy. It even increases channel wide profit by 14.9% compared with it in a VMI only policy.

articleTitle: Probability analysis of concrete slab cracking during construction
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The concrete slab cracking during construction should be based on the comprehensive understanding of loads, load effects ,structural resistance and available safety index of the structure. In this article, authors discussed the characteristics and probabilistic models of resistance, loads , and load effects, and analyzes cracking risk according to probability of concrete structure during construction. It was a complex of procedure, mainly including thermal, dry shrinkage and shore. The calculation results show that the critical cracking risk can be applied to real engineering. It is helpful to optimize concrete proportion and reduce the concrete structure cracking. Furthermore, a new system of quality management and control of concrete buildings during construction is proposed. It combines processes quality management with protection of processes product. The results of engineering applying show that this system helps to improve the engineering quality.

articleTitle: Company characteristics, macroeconomic conditions and dynamic capital structure adjustment in China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 17Th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Target capital structure choice and capital structure adjustment speed vary over time due to the different company characteristics and macroeconomic conditions. Based on the unbalanced panel data of Chinese nonfinancial listed companies from 1997 to 2006, this article builds a partial adjustment capital structure model which endogenize some decisive factors of target capital structure, and the empirical results show that the company's capital structure is significantly influenced by firm-specific characteristics as well as macroeconomic factors, and the adjustment speed of company's capital structure is significantly influenced by macroeconomic factors which are defined by GDP growth rate or term spread. Companies adjust to their target leverage faster in good macroeconomic conditions than in bad macroeconomic conditions.
